english: He was elected with 56,337 votes out of 70,252 total valid votes cast equivalent to 80.2% of total valid votes cast.

kusaal: Ba da vɔɔt o ka bas Ebenezer Obu Tette onɛ da an Peoples' National Convention nid, Nana Appia Manu Ma'asim tiig Na'adɔɔg National Democratic Congress nid, Munni Issah onɛ an Convention People's Party nid nɛ Ben Owusu Boadu onɛ an Every Ghanaian Living Everywhere Na'adɔɔg nid.
english: He was elected over Ebenezer Obu Tetteh of the Peoples' National Convention, Nana Appia Manu of the National Democratic Congress, Munni Issah of the Convention People's Party and Ben Owusu Boadu of the Every Ghanaian Living Everywhere political party.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusa ayi nɛ anii la ni, 2008, o da lɛn dɔlisi Wabʋg Na'adɔɔg la, New Patriotic Party ka ba vɔɔti tis o sʋ'ʋlim kan ya'as.
english: In 2008, he won the general elections on the ticket of the New Patriotic Party for the same constituency.

kusaal: O da paam vɔɔt tusa pisnaasi nɛ ayuobʋ, kɔbisyubʋ nɛ anu (46,605) yi vɔɔtnam tusa pisyɔpɔi nɛ ayi, kɔbiswai nɛ pisyɔpoi nɛ atan (72,973) dinɛ an pisyuobʋ nɛ atan du'al pisnii nɛ ayɔpɔi Kɔbiga pʋʋgin (63.87%).
english: He was elected with 46,605 votes out of 72,973 total valid votes cast equivalent to 63.87% of total valid votes cast.

kusaal: Ba da vɔɔt o ka bas Chogkureh Christopher onɛ an Ma'asimtiig Na'adɔɔg, National Democratic Congress nid, Yaw Frimpong and independent party.
english: He was elected over Chogkureh Christopher of the National Democratic Congress and Yaw Frimpong and independent party.

kusaal: O da paam vɔɔt tusa pisi nɛ ayɔpɔi, kɔbisnaasi nɛ pisnu nɛ ayuobʋ (27,456) yi vɔɔ tusa pisnaasi nɛ anu, kɔbisnii nɛ pisnaasi nɛ awai (45,849) dinɛ zɛm nɛ pisnu nɛ awai du'al pisnii nɛ anii kɔbiga pʋʋgin (59.88%) .
english: He was elected with 27,456 votes out of 45,849 total valid votes cast equivalent to 59.88% of total valid votes cast.

kusaal: ba da vɔɔt o ka bas Anthony Bernard Ansah onɛ an Ma'asim tiig Na'adɔɔg, National Democratic Congress nid, Kwadwo Amponsah onɛ an Progressive People's Party nɛ Dickson Osei-Asibey onɛ pʋ mɔr Na'adɔɔgɔ.
english: He was elected over Anthony Bernard Ansah of the National Democratic Congress, Kwadwo Amponsah of the Progressive People's Party and Dickson Osei-Asibey an independent candidate.

kusaal: Benito da lɛn di yʋʋm tusa ayi nɛ piinɛ ayuobʋ (2016) nɛ yʋʋm tusa ayi nɛ pisi (2020) vɔɔtʋg keŋ Wadmaanib yikanɛ paasi ayɔpɔi nɛ anii la Gaana Republic kanɛ paasi anaasi la ni.
english: Benito was re-elected in 2016 and 2020 general election to represent in the 7th and 8th Parliament of the Fourth Republic respectively.

kusaal: Owusu-Bio anɛ Kristo biig ka ken Anglican church.
english: Owusu-Bio is a Christian and a member of the Anglican church.

kusaal: O anɛ Wadmaan tis Atwima-Nwabiagya constituency bɛ Ashanti Region, Ghana la sʋ'ʋlim dim.
english: He is the Member of Parliament representing Atwima-Nwabiagya constituency of the Ashanti Region of Ghana in the 4th,5th,6th, 7th and the 8th Parliament of the 4th Republic of Ghana.

kusaal: O paas Ghana Wadmaanib yikanɛ paasi anaasi anu ayuobʋ, ayɔpɔi nɛ anii Ghana Republic kanɛ paasi anaasi la ni.
english: He is the Member of Parliament representing Atwima-Nwabiagya constituency of the Ashanti Region of Ghana in the 4th,5th,6th, 7th and the 8th Parliament of the 4th Republic of Ghana.

kusaal: Ba da du'a Owusu nɛ yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ pisyuobʋ nɛ anii Nwadis piinɛ yinne la.
english: Owusu was born on November 1, 1968.

kusaal: yiiga daar, November 1, 1968.
english: Owusu was born on November 1, 1968.

kusaal: Owusu paasnɛ Wabʋg Na'adɔɔg la ni, New Patriotic Party.
english: Owusu is a member of the New Patriotic Party.

kusaal: O da lieb Wadmaanɛ yʋʋm tusa ayi nɛ anu yʋʋmpaal Nwadig la ni (January 2005) on da di yʋʋm tusa ayi nɛ anaasi Nwadis piinɛ ayi vɔɔtʋg la (December 2004) nya'aŋ.
english: He became a member of parliament from January 2005 after emerging winner in the General Election in December 2004.

kusaal: O anɛ Wadmaani tis Atwima-Nwabiagya North constituency sʋ'ʋlim dim.
english: He is the MP for Atwima-Nwabiagya North constituency.

kusaal: Ba da vɔɔt o ka o keŋ Wadmaanib yikanɛ paasi anaasi, anu, ayuobʋ nɛ ayɔpɔi la Ghana Republic kanɛ paasi anaasi la ni.
english: He was a member of the Roads and Transport Committee and the Public Accounts Committee in the 7th Parliament of the 4th Republic of Ghana.

kusaal: Bama wʋsa da paamnɛ yinne kɔbiga pʋʋgin, (1.0%) piinɛ ayɔpɔi du'al yinne kɔbiga pʋʋgin (17.1%), yinne du'ali anu kɔbiga pʋʋgin (1.5%) nɛ nɛɛm du'ali atan kɔbiga pʋʋgin (0.3%) ba yʋda la dɔl taaba si'em la.
english: These obtained 1.0% 17.1%, 1.5% and 0.3% respectively of total valid votes cast.

kusaal: Kɔbiga pʋʋgin ba da paamnɛ piinɛ ayɔpɔi du'al ayɔpɔi (17.07%) nɛ piinɛ awai du'al ayuobʋ (19.06%).
english: These obtained 17.07% and 19.06% respectively of the total votes cast.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusa ayi nɛ piinɛ ayi la ni, 2012, o da lɛn zi'en Wabʋg Na'adɔɔg zug, ka ba vɔɔti tis o ya'as sʋ'ʋlim kan nɔɔ ni.
english: In 2012, he won the general elections on the ticket of the New Patriotic Party for the same constituency.

kusaal: O mɔr pʋ'a nɛ biisi atan.
english: He is married with three children.

kusaal: Wabʋg Na'adɔɔg la da di kʋgʋs bɛdigʋ, kɔbiga nɛ pisi nɛ anii (128) yi kɔbisyi' nɛ pistan (230) pʋʋgin.
english: The New Patriotic Party won a majority total of 128 parliamentary seats out of 230 seats.

kusaal: Wbʋg Na'adɔɔg la da di kʋgʋs bi'ela, kɔbiga nɛawai (109) yi kɔbisyi' nɛ pistan (230) pʋʋgin.
english: The New Patriotic Party won a minority total of 109 parliamentary seats out of 230 seats.

kusaal: Kɔbiga pʋʋgin bama da paamnɛ piinɛ anii du'ali ayi (18.2%), nɛɛm du'al pisnii nɛ anaasi (0.84%) nɛ pisi nɛ yinne du'ali anii (21.08%) ba yʋda la tun taaba si'em la.
english: 12,13 These obtained 18.2%, 0.84% and 21.08% respectively of the total votes cast.

kusaal: O da naae Mfantsipim School nɛ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology.
english: He is a graduate of Mfantsipim School and Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology.

kusaal: Onɛ an kpɛɛm kanɛ buon chief executive officer tis Ghana National Gas Company.
english: He is the chief executive officer of the Ghana National Gas Company.

kusaal: Benjamin Asante anɛ Asante-Akyem nid ka yit Juansa ka ba da dʋ'a o Kumasi linɛ bɛ Ashanti Region Ghana sʋ'ʋlim ka o dʋ'adib an Kwasi Aninakwa-Asante nɛ Gladys Mensah.
english: Benjamin Asante is an Asante-Akyem from Juansa and was born in Kumasi in the Ashanti Region of Ghana to Kwasi Aninakwa-Asante and Gladys Mensah.

kusaal: O da kɛŋ sakur nɛ Bantama/Asokwa Presby primary schools, nɛ State Experimental nɛ City of Kumasi middle schools.
english: He attended the Bantama/Asokwa Presby primary schools, and State Experimental and City of Kumasi middle schools.

kusaal: On da di ya'ani bɛ akarimgaad taaba ni la, O da tɔlisi kɛŋ Mfantsipim School linɛ bɛ Cape Coast la, anina ka o da paam o GCE Ordinary Level nɛ GCE Advanced Level kasɛta gbana.
english: Upon passing his common entrance exam, he was admitted into Mfantsipim School in Cape Coast, where he obtained his GCE Ordinary Level and GCE Advanced Level certificates in science.

kusaal: O da tɔlis tuoni kɛŋ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, Kumasi, da di'e kasɛta gbaʋŋ kanɛ buon Bachelor of Science in chemical engineering.
english: He proceeded to Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, Kumasi, and graduated with a Bachelor of Science in chemical engineering.

kusaal: O da tɔlisi kɛŋ University of Calgary, Canada, da maal o Master's degree in chemical engineering.
english: He later enrolled at the University of Calgary, Canada, where he pursued a Master's degree in chemical engineering.

kusaal: O lɛn paam zamisigi bɛ Multiphase (Oil and Gas) Flow bɛ Imperial College London ka University of Calgary ka o di'e gbaʋŋ kanɛ an PhD in chemical engineering.
english: He also completed a joint dissertation on Multiphase (Oil and Gas) Flow at Imperial College London and the University of Calgary and obtained a PhD in chemical engineering.

kusaal: On da naae university yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ pisnii nɛ anaasi ni la, Asante da di'e gbaʋŋ ye o kɛŋ National Industrial Company linɛ bɛ Kumasi la maal o national service.
english: Upon graduating from university in 1984, Asante was posted to the National Industrial Company in Kumasi for his national service.

kusaal: O mɛ tʋm inginiya tʋʋma, nɛ tʋʋm si'eba bɛdigʋ bɛ dunia tɛɛns bɛdigʋ ni, tɛɛns la si'eba an Abu Dhabi, Argentina, Australia, Bangladesh, Bolivia, Brazil, Canada, Chile, China, Colombia, Ghana, Indonesia, Malaysia, Mexico, Pakistan, Papua New Guinea, Peru, Russia, South Korea, Thailand, Vietnam, nɛ US.
english: He has also provided engineering services, project management, and technical support for projects throughout the world, including Abu Dhabi, Argentina, Australia, Bangladesh, Bolivia, Brazil, Canada, Chile, China, Colombia, Ghana, Indonesia, Malaysia, Mexico, Pakistan, Papua New Guinea, Peru, Russia, South Korea, Thailand, Vietnam, and the US.

kusaal: O mɛ lɛn tʋm sa'an sa'an tʋʋma tis World Bank nɛ Asian Development Bank.
english: He has also provided consulting services to the World Bank and Asian Development Bank.

kusaal: O tʋm tʋʋma bɛ Nova-Trans Canada, Jacobs Engineering, nɛ Enron.
english: His work profile includes periods at Nova-TransCanada, Jacobs Engineering, and Enron.

kusaal: Asante paas nidib anu banɛ yit Africa ka ba da buolil ba bɛ United States Department of Energy ye ba sʋŋi sɔb gbaʋŋ pɛbisim nam kɔn'ɔb kɔn'ɔb yela.
english: Asante was one of only five Africans to be invited by the United States Department of Energy to help author a book on natural gas and liquefied natural gas.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ ayɔpɔi, yʋʋm paal nwadig la ni, President Nana Akufo-Addo da gaŋ o ye o an CEO tis Ghana Gas.
english: In January 2017, President Nana Akufo-Addo appointed him as acting CEO of Ghana Gas.

kusaal: Ban pʋtɛn'ɛr da anɛ ye Asante da paas yelsi'eba pʋʋgin ak li da ka' sʋ'ʋm, on da tʋmmi bɛ Ghana National Petroleum Corporation la.
english: According to one of the groups, they were of the view that Asante had superintended many controversial deals whilst he was consulting for the Ghana National Petroleum Corporation.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ ayɔpɔi, Fulumfug nwadig la ni, Awulae Agyevi Kwame II, Paramount chief of Nsein, na'ab kanɛ da gaad tuoni bɔɔd ye gomɛna ti'akim o la da yina nwɛ'ɛ nyɔ'ɔg ye on na tʋm nɛ o, o da bas pʋtɛn'ɛr kanɛ ka o da mɔri bɔɔd ye ba gaŋ o tɛŋ nid la.
english: In February 2017, Awulae Agyevi Kwame II, Paramount chief of Nsein, who had been leading calls for the president to cancel the appointment of Asante, pledged to work with him, conceding defeat in his bid to get a native of the land to be appointed to the position.

kusaal: Benjamin K. D. Asante anɛ Ghana nid kanɛ an inginiya ka lɛn an ninkanɛ sa'an tɛɛns kɔn'ɔb kɔn'ɔb kpaam kɔn'ɔb kɔn'ɔb tʋʋma yela.
english: Benjamin Asante is an Asante-Akyem from Juansa and was born in Kumasi in the Ashanti Region of Ghana to Kwasi Aninakwa-Asante and Gladys Mensah.

kusaal: O tʋm ntɛ tʋʋma zin'is bɛdigʋ bɛ Canada, US, nɛ Ghana an tuongat ka sa'aliba zin'is bɛdigʋ.
english: He has worked for major operating companies as well as engineering consulting companies in Canada, the US, and Ghana in various technical and management roles.

kusaal: Asante zamis nidib banɛ naae ba yiiga univɛsity zamisig ka tɔlisid tuon la ban fʋn'ɔd kpaam yit tɛŋin si'em bɛ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology nɛ Imperial College, London.
english: Asante has taught gas processing and pipeline engineering to graduate students at Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology and Imperial College, London.

kusaal: O baŋir da yi paalʋ ni na nɛ yʋʋm tusayi nɛ ayɔpɔi ni ka Ghana nyɛ ka kpaam bɛ tɛŋin la zuoe la.
english: He was the technical director of Ghana's first gas infrastructure project and also developed the first gas infrastructure and utilization master plan for Ghana in 2008.

kusaal: O da paasi pansig gaas yela zaba kanɛ da bɛ Bolivia nɛ Brazil yʋʋm tusayi nɛ anaasi.O tum kpaam tuuma dunia zin'is bedigu.
english: He was an expert witness in the resolution of the gas custody dispute between Bolivia and Brazil in 2004.

kusaal: Asante da di'e nɛ George Yankey nɔbir, onɛ da yel tʋmtʋmnib kpɛɛmnam la ye o bɔɔd saŋa ye o kʋli vʋ'ʋs la.
english: Asante replaced George Yankey, who had asked for a terminal leave from the Board of Ghana Gas.

kusaal: Ban da gaŋ o nya'aŋ la, nidib si'eba banɛ da bɛ Nzema sʋ'ʋlim baba, zin'ig kanɛ ka Ghana Gas bɛ la da pʋ si'ak nɛ ban da gaŋ Asante la.
english: Upon his appointment, some groups in the Nzema area, where the operations of Ghana Gas are situated, questioned the president's decision to appoint Asante.

kusaal: Benjamin Bimpong Donkor (dʋ'am 7 July 1959) anɛ Ghana ninkanɛ maan politis ka lɛn an Wina'am tʋmtʋm.
english: Benjamin Bimpong Donkor (born 7 July 1959) is a Ghanaian politician and a reverend minister.

kusaal: Donkor yinɛ Jukwa-Mfuom linɛ bɛ Central Region Ghana sʋ'ʋlim.
english: Donkor hails from Jukwa-Mfuom in the Central Region of Ghana.

kusaal: O paam zamisig gbaŋ Diploma in Biblical Studies yinɛ Heritage Bible Institute yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ piswai nɛ anii ni.
english: He obtained his Diploma in Biblical Studies from the Heritage Bible Institute in 1998.

kusaal: Nidib la da gaŋ o ka bas on da nya'a nɛ sɔ', Peter Bright Amankrah onɛ da zi'en National Democratic Congress na'adɔɔg nɔba zug la.
english: He was elected over the only other candidate in that elections Peter Bright Amankrah of the National Democratic Congress.

kusaal: Ba da vooti tis o ka bas Godfred Appiah onɛ da zi'en People's National Convention na'adɔɔg nɔba zug la, nɛ Foster Joseph Andoh onɛ da zi'en National Democratic Congress na'adɔɔg nɔba zug, nɛ Osei Heyman onɛ da zi'en Convention People's Party na'adɔɔg nɔba zug nɛ Bright Wireko-Brobby onɛ da zi'en o mɛŋ nyali la.
english: He was elected over Godfred Appiah of the People's National Convention, Foster Joseph Andoh of the National Democratic Congress, Osei Heyman of the Convention People's Party and Bright Wireko-Brobby an independent candidate.

kusaal: Wan wʋʋ yʋda la tʋn si'em la, ban da paam voot si'em kɔbiga pʋʋgin anɛ 1.17%, 28.46%, 2.16% nɛ 32.92%.
english: These obtained 1.17%, 28.46%, 2.16% and 32.92% of the total valid votes cast respectively.

kusaal: O da paas parliament of Ghana tis Hemang Lower Denkyira constituency lin da yi yʋʋm tusayi nɛ anu, yʋʋm paalig nwadig ni paae yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ atan', yʋʋm paalig nwadig la ni.
english: He was a member of parliament for the Hemang Lower Denkyira constituency from 7 January 2005 to 6 January 2013.

kusaal: Donkor anɛ Wina'am tʋmtʋm.
english: Donkor is a reverend minister.

kusaal: O anɛ karensaam bɛ Springs of Life Chapel International.
english: He is the pastor for Springs of Life Chapel International.

kusaal: Donkor da anɛ member of parliament tis Hemang Lower Denkyira constituency lin da yi yʋʋm tusayi nɛ anu, yʋʋm paalig nwadig ni, daba ayɔpɔi daar paae yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ atan', yʋʋm paalig nwadig, daba ayuobʋ daar ka o na'adɔɔg an New Patriotic Party.
english: Donkor was a member of parliament for the Hemang Lower Denkyira constituency from 7 January 2005 to 6 January 2013 on the ticket of the New Patriotic Party.

kusaal: Ba da gaŋ Donkor ye o ken parliament of Ghana tis Hemang Lower Denkyira constituency yʋʋm tusayi nɛ anaasi Ghana vootʋg saŋa la.
english: Donkor was elected as the Member of parliament for the Hemang Lower Denkyira constituency in the 2004 Ghanaian General elections.

kusaal: Lin pa'al ye o da zi'en o constituency nɔba zug yiiga daani paas wadmaanib banɛ da paas anaasi bɛ Ghana da sʋ'ʋg o mɛŋ soogia nam sʋ'ʋsin abʋnaasi zin'igin la.
english: Thus he represented the constituency for the first time in the 4th parliament of the 4th republic of Ghana.

kusaal: Donkor da zi'en nɛ New Patriotic Party na'adɔɔg nɔba zugu di ya'an la.
english: Donkor was elected on the ticket of the New Patriotic Party.

kusaal: O tɛŋin la da paas tɛɛns piinɛ ayuobʋ banɛ ka New Patriotic Party da paam na'am bɛ Central region vootʋg kan pʋʋgin la.
english: His constituency was a part of the 16 constituencies won by the New Patriotic Party in the Central region in that elections.

kusaal: New Patriotic Party da di na'am kʋgʋs kɔbiga nɛ pisi nɛ anii bɛ wadmaanib banɛ da paas anaasi daani bɛ Ghana da faan'e o mɛŋi yis soogia nam sʋ'ʋsin abʋnaasi daan nya'aŋ la.
english: In all, the New Patriotic Party won a total 128 parliamentary seats in the 4th parliament of the 4th republic of Ghana.

kusaal: Ba da lɛn vooti tis Donkor ye o an Member of parliament tis Hemang Lower Denkyira constituency yʋʋm tusayi nɛ anii vootʋg la ni.
english: Donkor was re-elected as the Member of parliament for the Hemang Lower Denkyira constituency in the 2008 Ghanaian General elections.

kusaal: O da zi'en o tɛŋ dim nɔba zug abʋyi' daani bɛ wadmaanib banɛ da paas abʋnu daani bɛ 4th republic of Ghana ni la.
english: He thus represented the constituency for the second time in the 5th parliament of the 4th republic of Ghana.

kusaal: Donkor da lɛn di' ya'ani dɔlis nɛ New Patriotic Party na'adɔɔg ni.
english: Donkor was re-elected on the ticket of the New Patriotic Party.

kusaal: O tɛŋin la da paas tɛɛns anii banɛ ni ka New Patriotic Party da di ya'ani bɛ Central region vootʋg kan pʋʋgin la.
english: His constituency was a part of 8constituencies won by the New Patriotic Party in the Central region in that elections.

kusaal: New Patriotic Party na'adɔɔg la da paam kʋgʋs kɔbiga nɛ ayɔpɔi bɛ wadmaanib banɛ da paas anu bɛ Ghana da nyɛ yɔlisim yi soogia nam nu'usin nya'aŋ la.
english: In all, the New Patriotic Party won a total 107 parliamentary seats in the 5th parliament of the 4th republic of Ghana.

kusaal: Donkor mɔr pʋ'a nɛ biis anu.
english: Donkor is married with five children.

kusaal: O anɛ Kristo nid ka kɛn Winpʋ'ʋs dɔɔg kanɛ buon Springs of Life Chapel International.
english: He is a Christian and a member of the Springs of Life Chapel International.

kusaal: Benjamin Edwin Quansah anɛ Ghana ninkanɛ maan politis ka da paas yiiga dim banɛ da kpɛn'ɛ parliament of Ghana nam banɛ da bɛ second republic of Ghana ni la, o da zi'en nɛ tis Shama Constituency ka na'adɔɔg kanɛ ka o da zi'en an Progress Party (PP).
english: Benjamin Edwin Quansah is a Ghanaian politician and member of the first parliament of the second republic of Ghana representing the Shama Constituency under the membership of the Progress Party (PP).

kusaal: Quansah da kɛŋ parliament nɛ yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ pisyuobʋ nɛ awai la ni, on da di ya'an ye o zin'in Shama parliamentary kuk zugu bɛ 1969 parliament vootʋg saŋa la, o na'adɔɔg da anɛ Progress Party (PP).
english: Quansah entered parliament in 1969, after winning the Shama parliamentary seat during the 1969 parliamentary election on the ticket of the Progress Party (PP).

kusaal: Vootʋg la ni, Quansah da paam nidib tusanu, kɔbisyuobʋ nɛ piinɛ yuobʋ ka ba vooti tis o, ka o da di' ya'a ka bas on da nya'ad na'am nɛ sɔ' ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Ghapson Kwesi ka o na'adɔɔg da an National Alliance of Liberals (NAL) ka o paam nidib tusir, kɔbisnu nɛ atan' ka ba vooti tis o, ka Kodwo Effirim Nunoo mɛ da zi'eni tis People's Action Party (PAP) na'adɔɔg ka nidib kɔbistan' nɛ pisnaasi nɛ atan' ma'a vooti tis o.
english: During the election, Quansah polled 5,616 votes, against Ghapson Kwesi of the National Alliance of Liberals (NAL) who polled 1,503 votes, and Kodwo Effirim Nunoo of the People's Action Party (PAP) who polled 343 votes.

kusaal: Ban da tis o ya'an ye onɛ di'e na'am kuk la bɛ yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ pisyuobʋ nɛ awai Ghana Parliament vootʋg ni linɛ ka ba da maal yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ pisyuobʋ nɛ awai, Mɔtul nwadig, dabpisi nɛ ayuobʋ daar la.
english: After being pronounced winner at the 1969 Ghanaian parliamentary election held on 26 August 1969, he was sworn into the First Parliament of the Second Republic of Ghana on 1 October 1969.

kusaal: O da an member of parliament ti paae yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ pisyɔpɔi nɛ ayi', yʋʋm paal nwadig dabpiinɛ atan' daar ka soogianam da faan'e na'am la yi Busia nu'usin la.
english: He served as a member of parliament until 13 January 1972 when the Busia government was overthrown.

kusaal: Benjamin Komla Kpodo anɛ Ghana pɔlitis nwɛ'ɛd ka an Wadmaani paas Ghana Wadmaanib yikanɛ paasi ayɔpɔi la, Gaaba Republic kanɛ paasi anaasi la ni tis Ho Central Constituency bɛ Volta Region sʋ'ʋlim la dim.
english: Benjamin Komla Kpodo is a Ghanaian politician and member of the Seventh Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana representing the Ho Central Constituency in the Volta Region on the ticket of the National Democratic Congress.

kusaal: Ba da du'a Kpodo nɛ yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ pisnu nɛ atan la Nwadis piinɛ ayi la dabpisi nɛ ayi la daar (December 22, 1953).
english: Kpodo was born on 22 December 1953.

kusaal: O yinɛ Tanyigbe, tenkanɛ bɛ Volta Region, Ghana la.
english: He hails from Tanyigbe, a town in the Volta Region of Ghana.

kusaal: O da maali o bachelor's degree in Administration-Accounting nɛ University of Ghana yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ pisnii (1980) la ni.
english: He obtained his bachelor's degree in Administration-Accounting option from the University of Ghana in 1980.

english: He was the member of parliament for the Atwima-Mponua constituency under the membership of the Progress Party from 1969 until 1972 when the Busia government was overthrown.

kusaal: Ba da dʋ'a Owusu nɛ yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ piinɛ ayɔpɔi, Fulumfug nwadig dabpiinɛ ayɔpɔi daar bɛ Twedieh tɛŋ kanɛ bɛ Kumasi Metropolis Ashanti Region sʋ'ʋlim linɛ bɛ Ghana.
english: Owusu was born on 17 February 1917 at Twedieh at town in the Kumasi Metropolis of the Ashanti Region of Ghana.

kusaal: O da naae sakur bɛ Presbyterian Training College ka ba yʋ'ʋn buoni li English Church Mission School, biis sakur kanɛ bɛ Kumasi.
english: He attended Presbyterian Training College now English Church Mission School, an elementary school in Kumasi.

kusaal: Anina ka o da paam Elementary Standard Seven sakur gbaŋ yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ pistan' nɛ ayuobʋ ni.
english: There he obtained his Elementary Standard Seven certificate in 1936.

kusaal: Owusu da anɛ tuongad, kpaad, soogia kʋdʋg ka nyaan kilim wadmaan.
english: Owusu was an administrator, farmer, and ex-serviceman prior to entering parliament.

kusaal: O da pin'il politis nwɛ'ɛb nɛ yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ pisyuobʋ nɛ awai ni, yʋʋm kan ka o da zi'en Progress Party (PP) na'adɔɔg zugu nya'a na'am, o da zi'en nɛ tis Atwima-Mponua constituency bɛ yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ pisyuobʋ nɛ awai vootʋg la ni.
english: He began his political career in 1969 when he became the parliamentary candidate for the Progress Party (PP) to represent Atwima-Mponua constituency prior to the commencement of the 1969 Ghanaian parliamentary election.

kusaal: Owusu da anɛ Kristo nid.

kusaal: O da mɔr pʋ'a nɛ biis piiga.

kusaal: O mɔnrɛ General Certificate Of Education (1986).
english: He holds a General Certificate Of Education (1986).

english: Ayiku is a member of the National Democratic Congress(NDC).

kusaal: O da di Wadmaani vɔɔtʋg la nɛ vɔɔt tusa pisnu nɛ anu, kɔbiswai nɛ pistan nɛ anii (55,938) dinɛ an pisnu du'al anu kɔbiga pʋʋgin (50.5%), ka onɛ tia'al o ka pʋn dɛŋim zin'i kʋk la zug la, Bernard Okoe Boye onɛ an Nwabʋg Na'adɔɔg ka ti buon New patriotic Party nid la paam vɔɔt Tusa pisnu nɛ anaasi nɛ pisyɔpɔi nɛ ayi (54,072) dinɛ an pisnaasi nɛ anii dua'ali anii kɔbiga pʋʋgin (48.8%).
english: He won the parliamentary election with 55,938 votes representing 50.5% of the total votes cast, beating his main opponent and incumbent member of parliament Bernard Okoe Boye of the New patriotic Party who obtained 54,072 votes representing 48.8% of the total valid votes cast.

kusaal: O paas la'asbanɛ gɔsid Food, Agriculture and Cocoa Affairs nɛ Members holding Office of Profit Wadmaan yikanɛ paasi anii la Gaana republic kanɛ paasi anaasi la ni.
english: He serves as a member of Food, Agriculture and Cocoa Affairs Committee and Members holding Office of Profit Committee respectively in the Eighth Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana.

kusaal: Ba da dʋ'a Ayiku nɛ yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ pisyuobʋ nɛ anaasi nwadisa anii la daba anu daar (5 August 1964).
english: Ayiku was born on 5 August 1964.

kusaal: Onɛ da zi'eni o Na'adɔɔg la nɔba zug yʋʋm tusa ayi nɛ pisi (December 2020) vɔɔtʋg la.
english: He was the party's candidate for the December 2020 election.

kusaal: O anɛ Kristo biig.
english: He is a Christian.

english: Sekyere was born on Friday, 4 March 1977 in Derma of the Ahafo region.

english: He was part of the Works and Housing Committee and also the Poverty Reduction Strategy Committee.

english: He was the ranking member for the Poverty Reduction Strategy Committee, also a member of the Lands and Forestry Committee and also Local Government and Rural Development Committee.

english: In 2018, he donated a school bus to the Samuel Otu Senior High School.

kusaal: o anɛ deputy Minister tis Ahafo region ka ba nan maal bʋmpaal la.

english: Benson Tongo Baba (born 23 September 1948) is a Ghanaian politician and member of the Seventh Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana representing the Talensi Constituency in the Upper East Region on the ticket of the National Democratic Congress.

english: Bentil is a surname.

english: He also holds a master's degree in Public Health (MPH) from Hamburg University of Applied Sciences () and an A1 certificate in German from the Geothe Institute, Accra.

english: Okoe-Boye had his house job at the Ghana Health Service from 2009 to 2012 at the Central Regional Hospital, Department of Surgery, Pediatrics and Obstetrics and Gynecology, Cape Coast, from 2009 to 2011, and then at the Department of Internal Medicine, Tema General Hospital.

kusaal: O daa kpɛlim bɛ ani an alaafi tʋn-tʋn yʋʋma anaasi ani ka o daa tʋʋm bɛ Kibi Government Hospital, Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology nɛ La General Hospital.
english: He then continued as a medical officer in the same institution for four years where he worked at Kibi Government Hospital, Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology and the La General Hospital.

kusaal: Pɔi ka o daa na lieb wadmaan , Oko-Boye daa anɛ alaafi tʋn-tʋn bɛ LekMA Hospital bɛ Accra.
english: Prior to his entry into parliament, Oko-Boye was a medical officer at the LekMA Hospital in Accra.

kusaal: Li nwadisi anaasi li daba anaasi daar bɛ yʋʋm tusa ayi nɛ piisi la ni ka gɔmɛna zugdaan Akufo-Addo gaŋi Okoe-Boye ka o an minista nya'andɔl bɛ alaafi lʋgir la, ka ba zuŋ o nɛ 21 April 2020.
english: On 4 April 2020, Okoe-Boye was nominated by President Akufo-Addo to serve as a deputy health minister and was subsequently sworn in on 21 April 2020.

english: He however lost the Ledzokuku parliamentary seat in the 2020 Ghanaian general election to Benjamin Narteh Ayiku of the NDC.

english: He is also a politician and was a member of the Seventh Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana representing the Ledzokuku Constituency in the Greater Accra Region on the ticket of the New Patriotic Party.

english: He was also the chief executive officer of the National Health InsuranceAuthority(NHIA) mandated to run the affairs of Ghana's pro-poor health insurance policy, the National Health Insurance Scheme (Ghana).

english: Bernice Adiku Heloo (24 September 1954 – 25 December 2024) was a Ghanaian politician who served as a Member of Parliament for the Hohoe Constituency.

english: Heloo attended Mawuli School and OLA Girls' Secondary School, Ho.

english: Heloo was the immediate past president of Society For Women and AIDS in Africa and founder of Prolink, an NGO in Ghana.

english: She was the member of parliament for Hohoe, Volta Region from January 7, 2013, to January 2021; this is her second term.
