kusaal: Yʋma tusa ayi nɛ piiga nɛ atan' Mɔtul Nwadig la ni (August 2013) la ni, Ian Jazzi da yisi o yʋma kanɛ pɛɛs pistan' nɛ ayi(32) bɛ In Stereo Volume II - Turn The Volume Up mixtape pɛɛs nɛ yʋm-yʋm maan-maanib(Producer Coptic la bɛdigʋ, rappers, Psalm 1, Christ Junkie nɛɛ D.E.M.
english: In August 2013, Ian Jazzi released the 32 track In Stereo Volume II – Turn The Volume Up mixtape, which featured Multi-Platinum Producer Coptic, rappers, Psalm 1, the Christ Junkie and D.E.M.

kusaal: On da bɛ University of Ghana la o da di'em nwɛnii Duncan n bɛ Shakespeare's Macbeth, nɛ Jerry bɛ Harold Pinters 'Betrayal', nɛ banɛ bɛ.
english: At the University of Ghana, he played Duncan in Shakespeare's Macbeth, and the role of Jerry in Harold Pinters 'Betrayal', among others.

kusaal: Yʋʋma tusa ayi nɛ anii(2008) la ni, Ian Jazzi da maal NT1 sɛnlʋŋ di'ema bɛ TV Africa, zin'ig kanɛ k aba sʋŋidi maan di'ema dinɛ k aba pian'ad nɛ nɔɔr, ka di da yuug kem paae wʋʋ episode nam bam piiga nɛ nɛ ayuobu.
english: In 2008, Ian Jazzi hosted the NT1 poetry show on TV Africa, a studio recording of poets performing the spoken word, which lasted for a single season of 16 episodes.

kusaal: Yʋʋma tusa ayi nɛ piiga(2010) la ni, Rite Multimedia dim da tis Ian Jazzi tʋʋma ka o da gɔsid dinɛ anɛ Basket Ball TV, ka lɛm bɛ TV Africa ya'as.
english: In 2010, Jazzi was contracted by Rite Multimedia, to host Basket Ball TV, also on TV Africa. The show covered the ongoing inter-community basketball competition held at Elwak Stadium, and was usually transmitted live from the stadium.

kusaal: Ka yʋʋma tusa ayi nɛ piiga(2010) la ni ya'as, Jaazi da di'em sini di'ema dinɛ ka di pian'azug an playboy in Desperation, an malisim di'ema tiivi n, ka di anɛ Dickson Dzapasu da gtsi di maalʋg yɛla, onɛ k aba da pian'a o yɛla yʋ'ʋŋ saŋa bɛ Ghana nɛ Nigeria.
english: Also in 2010, Jazzi played the role of a playboy in Desperation, a romantic-comedy television series, directed by Dickson Dzapasu, which aired night-time in Ghana and Nigeria.

kusaal: Yʋʋma tusa ayi nɛ piiga nɛ ayi(2012) la ni, da di'em sini di'ema dinɛ ka li pian'azug dasaŋ kanɛ an ligidi sɔb ka mɔri a-ʋkim-mɛŋ, onɛ kpɛn' yɛla ni ka buosi o bɛ TV ni Peep, ka li ane Shirley Frimpong Manso.
english: In 2012, he played the role of a rich and arrogant youth who got into trouble in the investigative TV series, Peep, which was produced and directed by Shirley Frimpong Manso.

kusaal: Yʋʋma tusa ayi nɛ piiga nɛ atan'(2013) la ni, Jazzi da di'em, di'emkanɛ ka li pian'azug an yee Nana bɛ African movie, Potomanto, ka onɛ da gɔsi li maalʋg yɛla anɛ Manso.
english: In 2013, Jazzi played the role of Nana in the African movie, Potomanto, which was also produced and directed by Manso.

kusaal: Yʋma tʋsa ayi nɛ piiga (2010) la ni, o da yʋmi o yiiga yʋma mixtape la'as In Stereo Volume 1, dinɛ ka Ghana dim da mɔri li hali.
english: In 2010, he co-produced and released his first mixtape album In Stereo Volume 1, which was well received in Ghana.

kusaal: Ian da nɔknɛ ayʋmi pɛdigid la nɛ nɛ nimua hali on da bɛ sakur titarin la Adisadel College yʋma tʋsa ayi nɛ yinne(2001) la ni.
english: Ian took rapping seriously while in high school at Adisadel College in 2001.

kusaal: yʋʋma la maalʋg Ian Jazzi da tʋm mɛ li wʋsa, ba mɛ da lɛm EL, Tnyce Canada nid ka nɛ maan yʋma tisid nidib la, Six45 nɛ Jae Milla.
english: While Jazzi was responsible for most of the production, it also featured productions from EL, the Canadian Producer Tnyce, Six45, and Jae Milla.

kusaal: Yʋm-yʋm Racquel, Taurian Devueax nɛɛ Yolanda Chioma Richard-Albert.
english: It featured singers Raquel, Taurian Devueax and Yolanda Chioma Richards-Albert.

kusaal: Dinɛ yɛla ka ba daa maal yʋma gɛnda bama la anɛ yee, ba da bɔɔdnɛ ye ba pa'al Jazzi mɔr mi'ilim sia nyaŋidi yʋmi dɔlisid bumnwɛ'ɛda la, ka lɛm nɔk bʋnsiaba nami pɛɛs ka li koɛmisid ka an siigin.
english: The purpose of the mixtape was to showcase Jazzi's versatile rap skills over more commercial beats; his poetic style, like his lyrical style, is primarily socially conscious, integrating elements of inspiration and spirituality.

kusaal: Yʋʋm 2009 ni Ma'asim Tiig na'am lʋgir la da di na'am yʋʋm 2008 vootʋg la nya'aŋ la, Murtala Muhammed, President John Evans Atta Mills da ngaŋ o ye o an National Coordinator of National Youth Employment Programme la (NYEP) nya'aŋdɔl lin la nya'aŋ la ka ba maligin maali li ka li yʋn an Ghana Youth Employment Agency, (GYEDA).
english: In 2009, after a change of political power from the NPP to NDC, Muhammed was appointed the deputy national coordinator of the National Youth Employment Program (NYEP) by John Evans Atta Mills which was later rebranded into Ghana Youth Employment Development Agency, (GYEDA).

kusaal: 2006 ni, zaŋi dɔlnɛ Professor Wayo Seini onɛ da an MP tis Tamale central la gba'anr zaŋi keŋ NPP yɛla, ba da maal Bye-elections nli' wada la.
english: In 2006, following the decision by Wayo Seini, MP for Tamale Central constituency to defect to the NPP, a by-election was declared to fill the vacancy.

kusaal: Muhammed da tʋm tis Parliament an Parliament nam ayuobo la tit 4th Republic of Ghana la.
english: Muhammed served as a member of parliament for the Nanton Constituency in the sixth Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana.

kusaal: O da paam voot kanl 10,369 n gaad o tiraan Abdul-Kareem Iddrisu onɛ da paam vootnam 8,667 la.
english: In December 2012, he won the parliamentary election to represent the Nanton constituency by garnering 10,369 votes representing 52.66% of the total votes cast against his closest contender who was the incumbent member of parliament, Abdul-Kareem Iddrisu who got 8,667 votes representing 44.02%.

kusaal: On da paam na'am la n tʋm yʋʋm saŋa ayinne nya'aŋ la, o da pʋ lɛn paam ya'as Vootʋg kanɛ da ti'al la ka Mohammed Hardi Tuferu da paam kʋk la.
english: In 2016, after serving one term in parliament, he lost his bid to be re-elected as member of parliament to Mohammed Hardi Tuferu.

kusaal: Tuferu da paamnɛ vootnam la 11,346 ka Muhammed paam vootnam la 10,451 Vootʋg la wusa ni.
english: Tuferu garnered 11,346 votes representing 51.84% against Muhammed's 10,451 votes representing 47.75% of the votes cast.

kusaal: Inusah Fuseini kanɛ da Parliament nidi tis Tamale Central la n da nga'ae ye o kʋ lɛn zi'en 2020 Parliament na'am vootʋg la, Ma'asim Tiig Parliament na'am lʋgir la da dignɛ zaalim tis onɛ na kena bood.
english: After the member of parliament for Tamale Central Inusah Fuseini decided not to seek re-election in the 2020 elections, Muhammed contested his Party's parliamentary primaries.

kusaal: Muhammed da tʋm linɛ an Information nɛ Media Relations nɛ Trade nɛ Industry minista nya'aŋdɔl John Mahama Na'am saŋa linɛ an 2013 nɛ 2017 teŋsʋg.
english: In March 2013, John Mahama appointed Muhammed as Deputy Minister for Information and Media Relations and subsequently Trade and Industry under the John Mahama government from between 2013 and 2017.

kusaal: Muhammed keŋnɛ GHANASCO sakur kanɛ bɛ Tamale la.
english: Muhammed Murtala began his basic education at Tamale Presby Basic School (Kulikuli School) before enrolling at Ghana Senior High School in Tamale.

kusaal: O anɛ da keŋ Tamale pa'anib sakurin la paam pa'an kasɛta gbauŋ A.
english: He was a trained teacher who held a teacher's certificate A from Tamale College of Education (TACE), formerly Tamale training College (TATCO).

kusaal: O da zanl kpeŋ kan la hali ti paae saŋkanɛ ka ba vooti ngaŋ Parliament nidi tis Nanton vootʋg sʋ'ʋlim la ni yʋʋm 2012 vootʋg la.
english: Muhammed went on to contest for the primaries in the Nanton Constituency and this time, he won to represent the NDC as its Parliamentary candidate for the 2012 election.

kusaal: Yiiga, Muhammed da zi'eni tis Ma'asim tiig la Kpeemnam gaansig ka pʋ paam ka Inusah Fuseini paam ya'as 2008 la ni tis NDC.
english: Muhammed stood for the NDC primaries but lost to Inusah Fuseini who eventually won the by-election to replace Wayo Seini.

kusaal: O da yuolim nlɔŋi keŋ nya' Nanton sʋ'ʋlim vootʋg bama ni.
english: In December 2012, he won the parliamentary election to represent the Nanton constituency by garnering 10,369 votes representing 52.66% of the total votes cast against his closest contender who was the incumbent member of parliament, Abdul-Kareem Iddrisu who got 8,667 votes representing 44.02%.

kusaal: [9][10] Samanpiid Nwadig la ni yʋʋm 2012, o da n di Nanton Parliament kʋk la Vootʋg saŋa la.
english: In December 2012, he won the parliamentary election to represent the Nanton constituency by garnering 10,369 votes representing 52.66% of the total votes cast against his closest contender who was the incumbent member of parliament, Abdul-Kareem Iddrisu who got 8,667 votes representing 44.02%.

kusaal: Sawina (August) 2019 la, o da paam primaries la.
english: In August 2019, he won the primaries after getting 737 votes against his two contenders Alhassan Adam and Abdul Hanan Gundado who got 181 votes and 319 votes respectively.

kusaal: [8] Vaala nwadig la yʋʋm 2013 ni, Zugraan John Dramani Mahama da n gaŋ o ka o tʋm linɛ minista nya'aŋdɔl tis Minista Mahama Ayariga, linɛ anɛ Ministry of Information nɛ Media Relations.
english: In March 2013, John Mahama appointed Muhammed as Deputy Minister for Information and Media Relations and subsequently Trade and Industry under the John Mahama government from between 2013 and 2017.

kusaal: Idana Asigri anɛ Ghana pɔlitis nwɛ'ɛd ka an wadmaani bɛ first parliament, Ghana second republic la ni zi'eni tis Tempane-Garu Constituency, o da zi'enɛ Progress Party (PP) nɔba zug.
english: Idana Asigri is a Ghanaian politician and member of the first parliament of the second republic of Ghana representing Tempane-Garu Constituency under the membership of the Progress Party (PP).

kusaal: O da paasnɛ yiiga wadmaannib yin la Ghana Second Republic la ni zi'eni tis Tempane-Garu Constituency bɛ Western region sʋ'ʋlim, Ghana la Progress Party (PP) nɔba zug.
english: He is a Member of the First Parliament of the Second Republic of Ghana representing the Tempane-Garu Constituency in the Western region of Ghana on the ticket of the Progress Party (PP).

kusaal: Ba da vɔɔti o nɛ yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ pisyuobʋ nɛ awai Ghana wadmaannib vɔɔtʋg la ni (1969 Ghanaian parliamentary election) 1st Parliament, Ghana 2nd Republic la ni.
english: He was elected in 1969 Ghanaian parliamentary election of the parliamentary term of the 1st Parliament of the 2nd Republic of Ghana.

kusaal: Parliament la da pin'ilnɛ yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ pisyuobʋ nɛ awai nwadis piiga la yiiga daar (1 October 1969) ka da gu'oe ban da faaen Na'am la ka bas Busia yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ pisyɔpɔi nɛ ayi' yʋʋmpaal nwadig la dabpiinɛ atan la daar (13 January 1972).
english: The Parliament started on 1 October 1969 and was suspended following the overthrow of the Busia government on 13 January 1972.

kusaal: O saam Maa Ligu Asigri Luut da anɛ Worikambo tenkanɛ bɛ Tempane - Garu bɛ Upper East region sʋ'ʋlim, Ghana la Na'ab.
english: His father Mahamadu Asigri Duut was the chief of Worikambo a town in Tempane - Garu in the Upper East region of Ghana.

kusaal: O anɛ Buudi kpɛɛm.
english: He is a Traditional Ruler.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusa ayi nɛ piiga nɛ ayuobu(2016) la ni o da pɛɛs nidib kɔbiga(Time 100) pʋʋgin banɛ mɔr baŋir dunia la wʋsa ni.
english: He was named in the Time 100 list of the Most Influential People in the World in 2016.

kusaal: O yʋ'ʋr da yiya on da nwɛ'ɛd Stringer Bell bɛ HBO sini linɛ buon The Wire (2002–2004), nɛ DCI John Luther bɛ BBC One sini kanɛ buon Luther (2010–2019), naar daan la da kɛ ka o di'e ya'an piini kanɛ an Golden Globe Award for Best Actor – Miniseries or Television Film ka ba da len gaŋ o nɔɔr anaasi ye o nya'a di'e piini bɛ Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Lead Actor in a Limited Series or Movie.
english: He rose to prominence playing Tim in Family Affairs, and in the USA playing Stringer Bell in the HBO series The Wire (2002–2004), and DCI John Luther in the BBC One series Luther (2010–2019), the latter of which earned him the Golden Globe Award for Best Actor – Miniseries or Television Film as well as four nominations for the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Lead Actor in a Limited Series or Movie.

kusaal: Ba mɛ da gaŋ o ye o gaad tuoni gɔs di'em kanɛ an Showtime di'ema ka li yʋ'ʋr buon The Big C (2011) la nɛ Apple TV+ di'em kanɛ buon Hijack la(2024).
english: He was also Emmy-nominated for his guest role in Showtime comedy-drama series The Big C (2011) and for his leading role in Apple TV+ thriller series Hijack (2023).

kusaal: O sini maalig pʋʋgin, o maal o mɛŋ one ka o nini kpi'em ka o pʋ zɔt dabi'em ka an zabzabid di'em kanɛ buon Beasts of No Nation (2015) linɛ kɛ ka o di'e piinkanɛ an Screen Actors Guild Award for Outstanding Actor in a Supporting Role ka ba len gaŋ o ye o nya'a di'e piini bɛ British Academy Film Award nɛ Golden Globe Award.
english: On film, Elba portrayed a ruthless and charismatic warlord in the Netflix drama Beasts of No Nation (2015) for which he received the Screen Actors Guild Award for Outstanding Actor in a Supporting Role as well as nominations for a BAFTA Award and Golden Globe Award.

kusaal: O da maal o mɛŋ wan wʋʋ Nelson Mandela bɛ sini kanɛ an Mandela: Long Walk to Freedom (2013) anina ka ba gaŋ o ye o di'e piini bɛ Golden Globe Award for Best Actor in a Motion Picture – Drama.
english: He portrayed Nelson Mandela in Mandela: Long Walk to Freedom (2013) for which he was nominated for the Golden Globe Award for Best Actor in a Motion Picture – Drama.

kusaal: O paasi maal sininam ka ba si'eba an American Gangster (2007), Obsessed (2009), Prometheus (2012), Pacific Rim (2013), Star Trek Beyond (2016), Molly's Game (2017), The Dark Tower (2017), Hobbs & Shaw (2019), nɛ The Harder They Fall (2021).
english: He has also acted in American Gangster (2007), Obsessed (2009), Prometheus (2012), Pacific Rim (2013), Star Trek Beyond (2016), Molly's Game (2017), The Dark Tower (2017), Hobbs & Shaw (2019), The Harder They Fall (2021), Three Thousand Years of Longing (2022) and A House of Dynamite (2025).

kusaal: O da la'as nɛ Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) ka maal o mɛŋi an Heimdall sini nam ayuobʋ ni, ka ba pin'il nɛ Thor (2011), nɛ DC Extended Universe ka len an Bloodsport bɛ The Suicide Squad (2021) ni.
english: Elba joined the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) portraying Heimdall in six films beginning with Thor (2011), as well as the DC Extended Universe playing Bloodsport in The Suicide Squad (2021).

kusaal: Ba da dʋ'a Idrissa Akuna Elba nɛ yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ pisyɔpɔi nɛ yi, nwadis awai, dabisa yuobʋ daar (6 September 1972) bɛ London Borough of Hackney, ka o saam an Winston Elba, one an daʋ kanɛ yit Sierra Leonean li, o da tʋm nɛ Ford Dagenham plant, ka o ma an Eve, one an Ghanaian nid.
english: Idrissa Akuna Elba was born on 6 September 1972 in the London Borough of Hackney, the only child to Winston Elba, a Sierra Leonean man who worked at the Ford Dagenham plant, and Eve, a Ghanaian woman.

kusaal: O dʋ'adib da la'as taaba nɛ Sierra Leone tɛŋin ka nyaan tu suori kɛŋ London.
english: His parents were married in Sierra Leone and later moved to London.

kusaal: Elba da nɔbig nɛ Hackney nɛ East Ham ka maal o yʋ'ʋr la giŋa ye "Idris" ka o sakur kanɛ bɛ Canning Town la, ka o da pin'il sini maalig.
english: Elba was raised in Hackney and East Ham and shortened his first name to "Idris" while at school in Canning Town, where he first became involved in acting.

kusaal: Elba nar ka o pʋ'ʋs The Stage nɛ ban da kɛ ka o yi paalʋ na.
english: Elba credits The Stage with giving him his first big break.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ pisnii nɛ yuobʋ (1986), o da pin'il o DJ tʋʋma nɛ on da sʋŋ o saambil o pʋ'adiir pʋʋgin la; yʋʋm yinne pʋʋgin, o da pin'il o mɛŋ DJ tʋʋma nɛ o zuanam.
english: In 1986, he began helping an uncle with his wedding DJ business; within a year, he had started his own DJ company with some of his friends.

kusaal: Elba da kɛŋ Barking and Dagenham College saŋa bi'ela, ka bas sakur yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ pisnii nɛ nii (1988) ka di ya'ani bɛ National Youth Music Theatre ban da sʋŋ o nɛ ligidi £1,500 Prince's Trust grant nya'aŋ la.
english: Elba briefly attended Barking and Dagenham College, leaving school in 1988 and winning a place in the National Youth Music Theatre after a £1,500 Prince's Trust grant.

kusaal: On da bɔɔd ye o sʋŋ o mɛŋ nɛ o tʋʋma pin'ilig saŋa la, o da tʋm tʋʋm bibis si'eba ka si'eba an tayanam kpɛn'ɛsig, cold calling nɛ yʋ'ʋŋ tʋʋma bɛ Ford Dagenham.
english: To support himself between roles in his early career, he worked in odd jobs including tyre-fitting, cold-calling and night shifts at Ford Dagenham.

kusaal: Elba da pin'il sini maalig nɛ Crimewatch murder reconstructions, ka yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ piswai nɛ anaasi (1994), o da paas BBC biis di'ema kanɛ buon The Boot Street Band la ni.
english: Elba's first acting role was in Crimewatch murder reconstructions, and in 1994, he appeared in a BBC children's drama called The Boot Street Band.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ piswai nɛ anu (1995), o da paasi maal sini kanɛ ka o pin'ili tʋm tʋʋm kir, ka li buon Bramwell, laafi yela sini kanɛ ka ba da maal yʋʋm tusir, kɔbisnii nɛ piswainam saŋa (1890s) England sʋ'ʋlim.
english: In 1995, he landed his first significant role on a series called Bramwell, a medical drama set in 1890s England.

kusaal: Sini la pin'ilig, series 1 ni, o da anɛ na'ab ka ba buon o ye Charlie Carter, one ka o pʋ'a kpi dʋ'am pʋʋgin ka o yʋ'ʋn zi' on na niŋ si'em gɔs o bibil la.
english: In an episode of series 1, he played a central character, an African petty thief named Charlie Carter, who lost his wife to childbirth and had to figure out how to support his newborn daughter.

kusaal: Tʋʋm kanɛ ka o da tʋm da pin'il nɛ yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ piswai nɛ nu (1995) on da maal o mɛŋ wʋʋ yalim nɛ sini kanɛ buon Absolutely Fabulous ni la.
english: His first named role arrived earlier in 1995 when he was cast as a gigolo on the "Sex" episode of Absolutely Fabulous.

kusaal: O da kɛŋ tuoni paasi maal sininam British television ni, ka ba si'eba an The Bill nɛ The Ruth Rendell Mysteries.
english: Many supporting roles on British television followed, including series such as The Bill and The Ruth Rendell Mysteries.

kusaal: O da paasi maal soap opera Family Affairs ka kɛŋ tuoni maal television di'ema kanɛ an Ultraviolet nɛ Dangerfield.
english: He joined the cast of the soap opera Family Affairs and went on to appear on the television serial Ultraviolet and later on Dangerfield.

kusaal: O da lɛb England saŋsi'eba ye o tʋm television ni tʋʋma, wan wʋʋ Inspector Lynley Mysteries.
english: He returned to England occasionally for a television role, such as a part in one of the Inspector Lynley Mysteries.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ yinne la (2001), Elba da maal o mɛŋ Achilles ka ba maal sini kanɛ buon Troilus and Cressida bɛ New York City.
english: In 2001, Elba played Achilles in a stage production of Troilus and Cressida in New York City.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ piswai nɛ ayɔpɔ ni (1997), o da paasya ka ba tɔlis sini kanɛ buon ye "Blood, Sweat and Tears" linɛ bɛ Silent Witness di'ema ni la.
english: In 1997, he starred in the first two episodes of the second series "Blood, Sweat and Tears" in Silent Witness.

kusaal: On da sʋŋ ka ba maal yʋʋm tusayi nɛ yinne (2001) di'em kanɛ an Law & Order la nya'aŋ, Elba o da paasi lɛn maal HBO drama series di'em kanɛ buon The Wire la.
english: After a supporting turn on a 2001 episode of Law & Order, Elba landed a starring role on the HBO drama series The Wire.

kusaal: Lin yi yʋʋm tusayi nɛ ayi (2002) kɛŋ paae yʋʋm tʋsayi nɛ anaasi (2004), Elba da di'em nɛ wan wʋʋ Stringer Bell nɛ di'ema la pʋʋgin, li da paasi kɛ ka nidib baŋ o yela United States.
english: From 2002 to 2004, Elba portrayed Stringer Bell in the series, perhaps his best-known role in the United States.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ anu la ni (2005), o da anɛ Captain Augustin Muganza bɛ Sometimes in April, HBO sini kanɛ pa'an Rwanda dim gaansig yela.
english: In 2005, he portrayed Captain Augustin Muganza in Sometimes in April, an HBO film about the Rwandan genocide.

kusaal: Elba da paaa yʋʋm tusayi nɛ ayɔpɔi (2007) BET special Black Men: The Truth.
english: Elba appeared on the 2007 BET special Black Men: The Truth.

kusaal: Sini kanɛ ka ba da yisi li yʋʋm tusayi nɛ anii, nwadis atan', dabpisi nɛ atan' daar (23 March 2008), alasid daar kanɛ da an Easter la, bɛ BBC One, ka nidib banɛ da gɔsi li an 6.3 million ka banɛ pʋdigi li tisi ba taaba an nidib pisi nɛ yɔpɔi, kɔbiga pʋʋgin (27%).
english: The series premiered on 23 March 2008, Easter Sunday, on BBC One, receiving a high 6.3 million viewers and 27% of the audience share.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ awai, pin'ilig nwaig la ni (January 2009), Variety da yis labaar ye Elba na di'e Charles Miner nɔbir, one ka on nɛ Dunder Mifflin regional manager Michael Scott (Steve Carell) mɔr tʋʋm yinne tis NBC sini kanɛ an The Office la.
english: In January 2009, Variety reported that Elba would portray Charles Miner, a new rival to Dunder Mifflin regional manager Michael Scott (Steve Carell) for NBC's The Office.

kusaal: 69th Golden Globe Awards sini yisib linɛ da an yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piineyi, pin'ilig nwadig, dabpisi nɛ nu (15 January 2012), Elba da di'e piinkanɛ an Best Actor in a Miniseries or Television Film on maal BBC di'em kanɛ buon Luther la.
english: At the 69th Golden Globe Awards telecast on 15 January 2012, Elba won Best Actor in a Miniseries or Television Film for his role on the BBC crime thriller series Luther.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ yɔpɔi ni (2007), Elba da si'ak ye o na gaad tuon ka ba maal sini kanɛ an Daddy's Little Girls, ka ba buon o anina ye Monty, one maan lɔrnam ka yɛɛd fʋʋg bʋlʋ ka nɔŋ pʋ'a kanɛ an one gɔsid wada tɛŋin la ka bɔɔd ye o sʋŋ o ka o di'e o biis.
english: In 2007, Elba signed on to play the lead role of the film Daddy's Little Girls, playing Monty, a blue-collar mechanic who falls in love with an attorney helping him gain custody of his kids, and finds the relationship and his custody hopes threatened by the return of his former wife.

kusaal: O da paasi maal sin ikanɛ an 28 Weeks Later (2007) nɛ This Christmas (2007), linɛ da kɛ ka ba paam ligidi wʋʋ $50 million ( da anɛ wʋʋ $70.8 million yʋʋm tusayi, nɛ pisi nɛ tan' ni, 2023) ka li kpɛn'ɛ ba tʋʋma ni yʋʋm tusayi nɛ ayɔpɔi (2007).
english: He appeared in 28 Weeks Later (2007) and This Christmas (2007), which brought in nearly $50 million (~$72.7 million in 2024) at the box office in 2007.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ anii (2008) la, o da paasi maal sini kanɛ an Prom Night nɛ Guy Ritchie zaba sini kanɛ buon Rockn Rolla.
english: In 2008, he starred in the horror film Prom Night and the Guy Ritchie London gangster film RocknRolla.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ awai (2009), o da paasi maal dabi'em sini kanɛ buon The Unborn nɛ Obsessed, sini kanɛ ka o da maal nɛ Beyoncé.
english: In 2009, he starred in the horror film The Unborn and in Obsessed, a thriller that had him cast opposite Beyoncé.

kusaal: Elba sini kanɛ da ti'all anɛ Legacy (2010), anina ka o maal o mɛŋ soogia kanɛ lɛb Brooklyn na, on kɛŋ Eastern Europe ka pʋ nyaŋi tʋm tʋʋm kanɛ yela ka o kɛŋ la, anina ka o yʋ'ʋn ieed suor ye o lɛn lɛb.
english: Elba's next film was Legacy (2010), in which he portrayed a black ops soldier who returns to Brooklyn after a failed mission in Eastern Europe, where he has undertaken a journey looking for retribution.

kusaal: O da paasi maal Dark Castle sini DC/Vertigo's The Losers, ka one da gɔsi li yela an Sylvain White, on da di'e Roque tʋʋma la, one an ba kpɛɛm nya'andɔli bɛ black-ops team ka ba mɔɔd ye ba yɔ' gɔmɛna sam bɛ'ɛd kanɛ ka o maali ba la zug.
english: He starred in Dark Castle's adaptation of DC/Vertigo's The Losers, under the direction of Sylvain White, in the role of Roque, the second-in-command of a black-ops team out for revenge against a government that did them wrong.

kusaal: Ba da maal sini la nɛ Puerto Rico, ka yʋʋm kanɛ ka ba da yisi li an yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piiga, nwadis anaasi ni (April 2010).
english: Filming took place in Puerto Rico, and the movie was released in April 2010.

kusaal: Elba da paasi maal Takers (2010).
english: Elba appeared in the thriller Takers (2010).

kusaal: Ba da buon o Heimdall bɛ Kenneth Branagh sini kanɛ an Thor (2011) la, ka li dɔl wʋʋ Marvel Comics superhero of the same name.
english: He played Heimdall in Kenneth Branagh's film Thor (2011), based on the Marvel Comics superhero of the same name.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piiga, nwadis anii ni (August 2010), Elba da paasi signed up to portray the title character in a reboot of James Patterson's Alex Cross ka ba buon franchise.
english: In August 2010, Elba signed up to portray the title character in a reboot of James Patterson's Alex Cross film franchise.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ yinne, nwadis ayi ni (February 2011), Tyler Perry da di'e o nɔbir.
english: However, in February 2011, he was replaced by Tyler Perry.

kusaal: Ghost Rider: Spirit of Vengeance (2011), the sequel to Ghost Rider (2007) nam ni, Elba da di'em di'ema kanɛ ka o maal o mɛŋ ye zabzabid kanɛ an danuud.
english: In Ghost Rider: Spirit of Vengeance (2011), the sequel to Ghost Rider (2007), Elba played an alcoholic warrior monk tasked with finding the title character.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛyi, nwadisayi ni (February 2012), Elba da pa'al ye o na maal o mɛŋ wʋʋ Nelson Mandela nɛ maal sini kanɛ buon Mandela: Long Walk to Freedom, li da pa'al nɛ o vʋm da an si'em la.
english: In February 2012, Elba confirmed that he would portray Nelson Mandela in the film Mandela: Long Walk to Freedom, which is based on his autobiography.

kusaal: On da ti'ebid ye o maal sini kan la, Elba da kpɛn'ɛs o mɛŋ sarega dɔɔgin yʋ'ʋŋ mum bɛ Robben Island, zin'ig kanɛ ka ba da kpɛn'ɛs Mandela la.
english: As part of his preparation for the role, Elba spent a night locked in a cell alone on Robben Island, where Mandela had been imprisoned.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ yuobʋ, nwadis ayuobʋ ni (June 2012), Elba da maal o mɛŋ Captain Janek bɛ Ridley Scott sini kanɛ buon Prometheus.
english: In June 2012, Elba portrayed the role of Captain Janek in Ridley Scott's Prometheus.

kusaal: O da paasi maal sini kanɛ an Pacific Rim (2013) ka ba buon o anina Stacker Pentecost.
english: He joined the cast of the film Pacific Rim (2013) in the role of Stacker Pentecost.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ naasi ni (2014), o da paasi maal No Good Deed anina ka o an ninkanɛ kʋʋd nidib.
english: In 2014, he starred in No Good Deed as a vengeful psychopathic serial killer.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ yɔpɔi ni (2017), o da pʋd o yʋ'ʋr Roland Deschain bɛ Stephen King sini kanɛ an The Dark Tower, ka paasi maal The Mountain Between Us nɛ Aaron Sorkin gaas sini si'a tuon ka li an Molly's Game la, on nɛ Jessica Chastain.
english: In 2017, he played Roland Deschain in the Stephen King film adaptation The Dark Tower, starred in The Mountain Between Us and Aaron Sorkin's directorial debut Molly's Game, alongside Jessica Chastain.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ nii, nwadis anaasi ni (April 2018), ba da tis labaar ye Elba na paasi maal sini ka ba buol o anina ye Charlie bɛ Netflix di'ema sini kanɛ an Turn Up Charlie.
english: In April 2018, it was announced that Elba was cast as Charlie in the Netflix comedy series, Turn Up Charlie.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛwai ni (2019), Elba da maal o mɛŋ nimbɛ'ɛdi bɛ sini kanɛ buon Fast & Furious Presents: Hobbs & Shaw, Fast & Furious lʋgir yinne, ka da lɛn pʋd o yʋ'ʋr ye Macavity bɛ Tom Hooper sini kanɛ dɔlnɛ Andrew Lloyd Webber yʋma, ka li yʋ'ʋr an Cats la.
english: In 2019, Elba starred as the villain in Fast & Furious Presents: Hobbs & Shaw, a spin-off of Fast & Furious franchise, and played Macavity in Tom Hooper's film adaptation of Andrew Lloyd Webber's musical, Cats.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ pisi nɛ yinne la (2021), Elba da maal o mɛŋ Robert "Milton" DuBois / Bloodsport maal James Gunn sini kanɛ buon The Suicide Squad la.
english: In 2021, Elba portrayed mercenary Robert "Milton" DuBois / Bloodsport in James Gunn's The Suicide Squad.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ pisi nɛ yi la (2022), Elba kʋkɔr ka ba da nɔki maal Knuckles the Echidna sini kanɛ buon Sonic the Hedgehog 2 la, linɛ da tɔlis nɛ sini kanɛ an Sonic the Hedgehog linɛ dɔl wan wʋʋ of the same name.
english: In 2022, Elba was the voice of Knuckles the Echidna in the film Sonic the Hedgehog 2, a sequel to the film Sonic the Hedgehog which is itself based on the franchise of the same name.

kusaal: O da da maal nid yinne sini tis Paramount+ ka lɛb ye o maal Sonic the Hedgehog 3, ayi' la wʋsa anɛ yʋʋm tusayi nɛ pisi nɛ anaasi la nib (2024).
english: He reprised the role in a self-titled solo series for Paramount+ and returned for Sonic the Hedgehog 3, both in 2024.

kusaal: Elba da maal o mɛŋ wan wʋʋ Solomon Reed nɛ bɛ Phantom Liberty, yʋʋm tusayi nɛ pisi nɛ tan' ka ba da paas si'elnam CD Projekt Red yʋʋm tusayi nɛ pisi (2020) di'ema sini kanɛ buon Cyberpunk 2077 la.
english: Elba provided voice-acting and his likeness to the character Solomon Reed in Phantom Liberty, a 2023 downloadable expansion for CD Projekt Red's 2020 video game Cyberpunk 2077.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ pisi nɛ anaasi, nwadis piinɛyinne, dabpisi nɛ ayi daar (22 November 2024), Deadline da yis labaar na ye ba na buol o Duncan, ninkanɛ mɔr zaba la'adi bɛ Amazon Prime sini kanɛ buon Masters Of The Universe la.
english: On 22 November 2024, Deadline announced he was cast as Duncan/Man-At-Arms in Amazon MGM Studios's film adapation of Masters of the Universe.

kusaal: Elba da tik nu'ug nɛ Apple tuuma zin'ig ye o maal sini dɔlis o Green Door Pictures sini maalig zin'ig la.
english: Elba signed a deal with Apple to produce original content through his Green Door Pictures production company.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ yinne, nwadisayi ni (February 2021), ba da yel ye Elba nɛ o pʋ'a Sabrina Dhowre sʋ'ʋe tʋʋma zin'ig si'a la bɔɔd ye bam aal sini kanɛ ka saalib kaee li pʋʋginɛ ka ba na buoli li ye Dantai, tis Crunchyroll, saŋkan ka biotech na "maal ka bʋnmɔrnam nɛ banɛ pʋ mɔra na baŋ taaba." Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ pisi nɛ yine, nwadis anaasi ni (April 2021) labadi'esidib da pian'ad tis Den of Geek, ka o yel ye sini la pa'al nɛ o pʋ'a nɛ o biig yela, one ka o pa'al ye o anɛ "geek nid kanɛ bɛɛ o kɔn' fʋ ya'a pian'ad sini yela".
english: In February 2021, it was reported that the companies of Elba and his wife, Sabrina Dhowre, would be developing an Afrofuturist adult animated sci-fi series, tentatively titled Dantai, for Crunchyroll, which would be about a time when biotech has "created an ever-widening gap between the haves and have-nots." In an April 2021 interview with Den of Geek, he said the series is "mainly the brainchild" of his wife, whom he described as a "super geek when it comes to anime".

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ pisi nɛ anaasi, nwadisayuobʋ ni (June 2024), Elba da pin'il sini maalig tʋʋma zin'ig ka pʋdi li yʋ'ʋr ye 22Summers on nɛ one da an Pulse nɛ BBC kpɛɛm ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Diene Petterle la.
english: In June 2024, Elba launched a new production company called 22Summers with former Pulse & BBC exec Diene Petterle.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi ne pisi nɛ anaasi, nwadisanii ni (August 2024), Elba da paam suor Tanzania gɔmɛna ni ye o pin'il sini maalig zin'igi bɛ Zanzibar.
english: In August 2024, Elba received approval from the Tanzanian government to establish a film studio in Zanzibar.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ pisi nɛ anaasi, nwadisawai ni (September 2024), Elba da la'as o mɛŋ nɛ Things Fall Apart anina ka o paasidi maan sini ka lɛn an tuongat.
english: In September 2024, Elba joined Things Fall Apart as an actor and executive producer.

kusaal: Elba da paasi maal yʋʋma sini tis Fat Joe (2002), Angie Stone (2004) nɛ rapper Giggs (2010).
english: Elba has appeared in music videos for Fat Joe (2002), Angie Stone (2004) and rapper Giggs (2010).

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ ayuobʋ ni (2006), o da maal yʋʋma four-song EP Big Man tis Hevlar Records.
english: In 2006, he recorded the four-song EP Big Man for Hevlar Records.

kusaal: O da paasi maal ka di'em bɛ Jay-Z album American Gangster (2007) ni.
english: He co-produced and performed on the intro to Jay-Z's album American Gangster (2007).

kusaal: O da anɛ DJ tis yʋʋm tusayi nɛ ayɔpɔi (2007) NBA All-Star parties linɛ da bɛ The Venetian nɛ Ice House Lounge linɛ bɛ Las Vegas.
english: He DJed at the 2007 NBA All-Star parties at The Venetian and Ice House Lounge in Las Vegas.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ awai, nwadisayɔpɔi ni (July 2009), Elba da anɛ DJ tis BET di'em kanɛ ka ba maan ka li buon Rising Icons la.
english: In July 2009, Elba was the DJ for BET's current series Rising Icons.

kusaal: O da yis labaar na ye o na yis yiiga yʋʋma "Please Be True" la.
english: He announced the release of his first single "Please Be True".

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ awai, nwadisanii ni (August 2009), o da yis labaar na pa'al ye o six-song EP yʋʋma la yʋ'ʋri an Kings Among Kings.
english: In the August 2009 issue of Essence, he announced the title of his six-song EP as Kings Among Kings.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ yinne ni (2011), o da maal di'ema bɛ Pharoahe Monch album W.A.R. zʋŋir la ni.
english: In 2011, he performed on the intro to Pharoahe Monch's album W.A.R..

kusaal: Li yʋʋm saŋa, o da paasi maal ka di'em bɛ Mumford & Sons yʋʋma sini "Lover of the Light" ni.
english: In the following year, he co-directed and performed in the Mumford & Sons music video for "Lover of the Light".

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ naasi (2014), o da maal K. Michelle yʋʋma kanɛ an "The Rebellious Soul Musical" linɛ da yi VH1 na yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ naasi, nwadisanii, dabpisi nɛ wai ni (19 August 2014).
english: In 2014, he produced K. Michelle's "The Rebellious Soul Musical" which debuted on VH1 on 19 August 2014.

kusaal: Nwadis anu la ni, Elba da paasi yʋm Mr Hudson yʋʋma kanɛ an "Step Into the Shadows" la.
english: In May, Elba featured on Mr Hudson's single "Step Into the Shadows".

kusaal: Mr Hudson da maal o di'em kanɛ an Idris Elba Presents Mi Mandela, ka ba da yisi li paalʋ na yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ anaasi, nwadis piinɛyinne ni (November 2014).
english: Mr Hudson also produced his album Idris Elba Presents Mi Mandela, released in November 2014.

kusaal: O mɛ da paasi maal Ghana yʋmyʋmdib VVIP yʋʋma kanɛ an "Selfie" on ne Nigeria dim rapper kanɛ ka buon o Phyno ka ba da yisi li yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ anaasi, nwadisawai, dabpiinɛyi daar (12 September 2014), sini la da yi YouTube ni yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ nʋ, nwadisanaasi, dabpiinɛ yinne daar (11 April 2015).
english: He also featured on the remix of the Ghanaian music group, VVIP's single "Selfie" together with Nigerian rapper Phyno released on 12 September 2014, and the video was released on YouTube on 11 April 2015.

kusaal: Elba da maal yʋʋma di'ema tis Noel Fielding nɛ Sergio Pizzorno yʋʋma kanɛ da paas ayi, ka ba buon Loose Tapestries.
english: Elba performed a rap for the second album by Noel Fielding and Sergio Pizzorno's band, the Loose Tapestries.

kusaal: Elba da paasi yʋʋm Skepta yʋʋm kanɛ buon "Shutdown" linɛ ka yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ nu, nwadisayuobʋ dabisir yinne daar (1 June 2015) ka ba da nɔki li niŋ Sound Cloud la.
english: Elba also rapped in a remix of Skepta's "Shutdown" which was uploaded on 1 June 2015 to SoundCloud.

kusaal: Nwadisanii dabpiinɛ yɔpɔi daar (17 August), ba da yis yʋʋma paalʋ ni na ka Elba paas nɛ Nigeria yʋmyʋm D'banj ka li yʋ'ʋr an "Confidential", ka Sierra Leon yʋmyʋm Shadow Boxer mɛ paas anina, ka ba da nɔki li niŋ YouTube nwadisanii dabpisi daar (20 August).
english: On 17 August, a song was released on which Elba appeared on Nigerian singer D'banj's single "Confidential", featuring Sierra Leonean rapper Shadow Boxer with the video uploaded to YouTube on 20 August.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ nu, nwadispiinɛ yinne ni (November 2015), Elba da buol Madonna on da maan o Rebel Heart Tour bɛ Berlin, Germany sʋ'ʋlim la.
english: In November 2015, Elba opened for Madonna during her Rebel Heart Tour in Berlin, Germany.

kusaal: Elba lɛn paasi yʋʋm Macklemore & Ryan Lewis yʋʋm kanɛ buon This Unruly Mess I've Made (2016) la.
english: Elba is also featured on the Macklemore & Ryan Lewis album This Unruly Mess I've Made (2016).

kusaal: O da mɔr pʋtɛn'ɛr ye o yis yʋʋma Idris Elba Presents Mi Mandela la di'ema, anina ka di'em kanɛ buon Tree la da yina ka ba da yisi li bɛ Manchester International Festival yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ wai ni (2019).
english: He had the idea to develop the music from his album Idris Elba Presents Mi Mandela into a show, which eventually resulted in a play called Tree that premiered at the Manchester International Festival in 2019.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛwai, nwadisayɔpɔi, daba yi daar (2 July 2019), The Guardian da yis labaar na pa'al ye gbansɔbidib Tori Allen-Martin nɛ Sarah Henley ye ba yisi ba bɛ di'em kaŋa pʋʋgin ka li pʋ dɔli li suorɛ.
english: On 2 July 2019, The Guardian published a story describing how writers Tori Allen-Martin and Sarah Henley said they had been removed from the production under what they described as questionable circumstances.

kusaal: Kwame Kwei-Armah da paas tʋʋm kaŋa ni yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ nii, nwadis anu ni (May 2018), ka maligin sɔbi ba gbana la zin'ig si'eba.
english: Kwame Kwei-Armah joined the project in May 2018, and rewrote part of their material.

kusaal: Li yiib saŋa la, banɛ da maal Tree "anɛ Idris Elba nɛ Kwame Kwei-Armah".
english: At the time of its premiere, Tree was billed as "created by Idris Elba and Kwame Kwei-Armah".

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ nii, nwadisayɔpɔi ni (July 2018), o da tis o yʋʋma tuʋma la yʋ'ʋr ye 7Wallace Music.
english: In July 2018, he launched his record label, 7Wallace Music.

kusaal: Elba da maal di'ema bɛ Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛwai, nwadisanaasi ni (April 2019).
english: Elba performed at Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival in April 2019.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛwai (2019), o da paas yʋʋm kanɛ buon "Boasty" la ni ka one da maal an British tɛŋ nid ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Wiley.
english: In 2019, he featured on the track "Boasty" by British grime artist Wiley.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ wai (2019), Elba da paasi maal Taylor Swift yʋʋma kanɛ buon "London Boy" linɛ yii o Lover album la ni.
english: In 2019, Elba appears on Taylor Swift's song "London Boy" from her seventh studio album Lover.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ pisi, nwadisanaasi ni (April 2020), Elba da la'as nɛ one gɔsid yʋʋma maalig Jay Robinson ka ba yʋʋm yʋʋma kanɛ buon "Know Yourself", linɛ ka ba da yisi li Mau5trap ni la.
english: In April 2020, Elba collaborated with producer Jay Robinson on the track "Know Yourself", released on Mau5trap.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ pisi ni (2020, on da wʋm Canadian R&B yʋmyʋm Emanuel ka o yʋʋm o yʋʋma kanɛ buon "Need You" la, Elba da paae o sa'an ye o maal yʋʋma sini nɛ o, ka li gban'e nidibi tɔnd la'ad ye li sʋŋi ba taaba bɛ COVID-19 pandemic saŋa la.
english: In 2020, after hearing Canadian R&B singer Emanuel's debut single "Need You", Elba reached out with an idea for a music video compiled from clips of people sharing the things that were helping them cope with the COVID-19 pandemic.

kusaal: Ba da maal Elba creative director tis sinikan, ka lɛn maal o executive producer bɛ Emanuel sini kanɛ ka ba da ye ba maal la.
english: Elba was credited as the creative director of the video and is being credited as an executive producer of Emanuel's forthcoming full-length debut album.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ pisi nɛ yinne, nwadisayi, dabpiinɛtan' daar (13 February 2021), Elba da anɛ DJ mix saan kanɛ ka ba kaanbi buol o bɛ Mix Up bɛnɛ Australian national youth broadcaster Triple J. Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ pisi nɛ yinne, nwadisawai, dabpisi nɛ ayi daar (22 September 2021), Elba da yis labaar ye o na la'as nɛ Australian pop rock yʋmyʋm kanɛ buon Lime Cordiale la ka ba yʋʋm yʋmkanɛ buon Cordi Elba la, ba da yis yʋmkan nɛ yʋʋm tusayi nɛ pisi nɛ yi, pin'ilig nwadig, dabpiinɛ naasi daar (14 January 2022).
english: On 13 February 2021, Elba performed a guest DJ mix for Mix Up on Australian national youth broadcaster Triple J. On 22 September 2021, Elba announced he would be releasing a collaborative EP with Australian pop rock duo Lime Cordiale titled Cordi Elba, which was released on 14 January 2022.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ pisi nɛ anaasi, pin'ilig nwadig, daba nii daar (8 January 2024), Elba da yis yʋʋma paal ka li buon "Knives Down" on nɛ UK rapper DB Maz ye li sʋŋi zabi gɛɛs nimbɛ'ɛdnam banɛ kuud taaba nɛ sʋ'ʋsi bɛ UK la.
english: On 8 January 2024, Elba released the song "Knives Down" featuring UK rapper DB Maz as a part of his campaign against knife crime in the UK.

kusaal: Walis bama anɛ 107.5 Darkstar Radio nɛ 99.9 Impulse Radio.
english: These are listed as 107.5 Darkstar Radio and 99.9 Impulse Radio.

kusaal: 107.5 Darkstar da pin'il yʋʋma ayi banɛ ka Elba da yʋʋm ("Choke Hold", "Roller Coaster"), ka 99.9 Impulse mɛ da bas hour-mum suori tis DJ set yinɛ Elba nɛ Private Press ni.
english: 107.5 Darkstar introduces two new tracks by Elba ("Choke Hold", "Roller Coaster"), and 99.9 Impulse features an hour-long DJ set by Elba and Private Press.

kusaal: Yʋʋmm tusayi nɛ pisinɛ anaasi, pin'ilig nwadig, dabpisi nɛ anaasi daar (24 January 2024), Movement Electronic Music Festival linɛ bɛ Detroit da yis labaar na ye Elba na paasi maal di'ema nɛ DJ set nɛ EDM DJ nɛ Kevin Saunderson bɛ yʋʋm tusayi nɛ pisi nɛ anaasi ni (2024).
english: On 24 January 2024, Movement Electronic Music Festival in Detroit announced that Elba would be performing a back-to-back DJ set with veteran EDM DJ and producer Kevin Saunderson in 2024.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ pisi nɛ anaasi ni (2024), Idris da pin'il o yʋʋma tʋʋma yʋ'ʋr ye "Sound International" ka li da anɛ o saambil yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ pisnii saŋa (1980s) London yʋʋma la'ad la, li da kɛ ka o pʋtɛn'ɛr yɔ'ɔg nɛ yʋʋma yela; tʋʋmkaŋa nwa' o da gban'e nɛ ye o kɛ ka nidib pa'ali ba baŋir dunia bɛn wʋsa, ka o bɔɔdim an ye o paam yʋmyʋmidib tɛŋ wʋsa paas, ka li pa'al ye ala'astaaba bɛɛ ba ni.
english: In 2024, Idris began his own label "Sound International" inspired by his uncle's legendary 1980s London "Sound System" which had an open-minded approach to music; the label aims to showcase diverse house music talent from around the world, with a goal to sign records from every country, highlighting the global unity and freedom within the house music genre.

kusaal: Discovery Channel da yis sini ka li yelzug an ye, Idris Elba: Fighter, ka li pa'al Elba nɔk nwadis piinɛyi zamis zaba ka ba buon kickboxing nɛ li buudi wʋsa o da zamisi yi nɛ Muay Thai one pa'ana zaba ka ba buon o Kieran Keddle la sa'an, anina ka Elba da pin'il o zaba di'ema yiiga—o da di ya—gɛɛs nɛ Lionel Graves, one da mɔr paŋ, ka zab ka li yʋʋg, bɛ London York Hall la ni.
english: Discovery Channel produced a documentary, Idris Elba: Fighter, chronicling Elba's twelve-month kickboxing and mixed martial arts training under Muay Thai coach Kieran Keddle, culminating in Elba's first professional kickboxing fight—and win—against Lionel Graves, a younger, more experienced Dutch opponent, at London's York Hall.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ pisi nɛ nu, nwadisayi, dabpiinɛ yinne daar (11 February 2025), labaar daar yina ye Elba nɔk ligidi kpɛn'ɛs Kiro Race Co, nimbanɛ la'asi paasi nya'adi bɛ FIA Formula E World Championship ni la.
english: On 11 February 2025, it was announced that Elba invested in Kiro Race Co, a team competing in the FIA Formula E World Championship.

kusaal: Elba da di nɛ Danish pʋ'a kanɛ buon Hanne "Kim" Nørgaard yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ piswai nɛ awai ni (1999) ti paae yʋʋm tusayi nɛ atan' (2003) ka ba bas taaba.
english: Elba was married to Danish stylist Hanne "Kim" Nørgaard from 1999 until their divorce in 2003.

kusaal: O da lɛn di nɛ America dim pʋ'akanɛ an lawyer ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Sonya Nicole Hamlin nwadis anaasi yʋʋm tusayi nɛ ayuobʋ ni (2006).
english: He was then married to American real estate lawyer Sonya Nicole Hamlin for four months in 2006.

kusaal: On nɛ Nørgaard mɔr bipʋŋ ka mɔr dasaŋ nɛ Naiyana Garth.
english: He has a daughter with Nørgaard and a son with English makeup artist Naiyana Garth.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ anaasi, nwadis piiga ni (October 2014), Elba da maal sini kanɛ an Journey Dot Africa with Idris Elba bɛ BBC Radio 2, ka pa'an Africa yʋʋma.
english: In October 2014, Elba presented the series Journey Dot Africa with Idris Elba on BBC Radio 2, exploring all types of African music.

kusaal: Elba da pian'ad television ni kuosid la'adi tis Sky box-sets yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ tan' (2013), yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ anaasi (2014), yuʋm tʋsayi nɛ piinɛ nʋ (2015), yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ ayuobʋ (2016) nɛ yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ wai (2019).
english: Elba was featured in various television commercials for Sky box-sets in 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016 and 2019.

kusaal: O da la'as nɛ UK parliament ban mugusid ye ba yis Ebola West Africa sʋ'ʋlim la, on nɛ UK Secretary of State for International Development Justine Greening yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ naasi (2014).
english: He has collaborated with the UK parliament in their efforts to eradicate Ebola from West Africa, working alongside the UK Secretary of State for International Development Justine Greening in 2014.

kusaal: Elba da la'as nɛ British fashion label Superdry, linɛ ka ba da pin'ili li yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛnu, nwadis piinɛ yinne la ni (November 2015).
english: Elba has created a collaboration with British fashion label Superdry, which launched at the end of November 2015.

kusaal: The Prince's Trust, linɛ an lʋgir kanɛ sʋŋid UK dasam nɛ pʋ'asada ka one da pin'ili li an Prince Charles yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ pisyɔpɔi nɛ ayuobʋ ni (1976), Elba da tʋm nɛ ba, ka ba gaŋ o ye o an tuongati gɔsid yɛlbɛ'ɛdnam yela yʋʋm tusayi nɛ awai, nwadis anaasi ni (April 2009).
english: The Prince's Trust, a UK youth charity founded by Prince Charles in 1976, which Elba credits with helping begin his career, appointed him as their anti-crime ambassador in April 2009.

kusaal: O da paas kpɛɛmnam banɛ an Board of Governors tis British Film Institute lin yi yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ nii (2018) paae yʋʋm tusayi nɛ pisi nɛ ayi (2022).
english: He served on the Board of Governors of the British Film Institute between 2018 and 2022.

kusaal: O kʋkɔr da paas European Union vootʋg kanɛ da bɛ 2016 United Kingdom European Union membership referendum.
english: He voiced support for a vote to remain in the European Union for the 2016 United Kingdom European Union membership referendum.

kusaal: Elba da kɛŋ UK gɔmɛna la'as kanɛ pa'an banɛ mɔr sʋ'ʋsi tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd yela yʋʋm tusayi nɛ pisi nɛ anaasi (2024), on nɛ Prime Minister Keir Starmer nɛ Home Secretary Yvette Cooper.
english: Elba attended the UK government's inaugural knife crime summit in 2024, alongside Prime Minister Keir Starmer and Home Secretary Yvette Cooper.

kusaal: O anɛ one sʋŋid Arsenal FC.
english: He is a lifelong supporter of his local football team Arsenal.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ nu ni (2015), lʋgir kanɛ ka o mɔr ka li an Idris Elba: No Limits la ni, Elba da zɔɔ tʋʋg ban mi' zɔɔ paae si'em bɛni bɛ Pendine Sands ka ba buon "Flying Mile" di'ema la ni.
english: In 2015, as part of his Discovery Channel miniseries Idris Elba: No Limits, Elba broke the land speed record for the Pendine Sands "Flying Mile" course.

kusaal: O da gaad tuoni gɔs The Best FIFA Football Awards linɛ da bɛ London Palladium ni yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ yɔpɔi, nwadis piiga, dabpisi nɛ atan' daar (23 October 2017), anina ka o nɔk foto nɛ Lionel Messi, Cristiano Ronaldo, nɛ Neymar.
english: He hosted The Best FIFA Football Awards at the London Palladium on 23 October 2017, during which he took a selfie of "the best team in the world" which included Lionel Messi, Cristiano Ronaldo and Neymar.

kusaal: Ba da gaŋ Elba ye one an Essence's Sexiest Man of the Year yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ tan' ni (2013) nɛ People's Sexiest Man Alive yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ nii (2018).
english: Elba was named Essence's annual Sexiest Man of the Year in 2013 and People's Sexiest Man Alive in 2018.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi na piinɛ anaasi, nwadis piiga ni (October 2014), da da tis o piinkanɛ an MOBO Inspiration Award.
english: In October 2014, he was presented with a MOBO Inspiration Award.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛwai, nwadisanu la (May 2019), o sini da paas ligidi ka li gaad $9.8 billion bɛ global box office, ka paae $3.6 billion bɛ North America, anina ka o paas sini maanib pisi banɛ mɔr ligidi.
english: As of May 2019, his films have grossed over $9.8 billion at the global box office, including over $3.6 billion in North America, where he is one of the top 20 highest-grossing actors.

kusaal: Ba da gaŋ Elba ye o an kpɛɛm bɛ Order of the British Empire (OBE) yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ yuobʋ ni (2016) ye o gɔs sini maalig yela.
english: He was appointed an Officer of the Order of the British Empire (OBE) in the 2016 New Year Honours 'for services to drama'.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ yɔpɔi ni (2017), o da di ya'an kanɛ buon "Rear of the Year" Britain tɛŋin.
english: In 2017, he won the male title for the "Rear of the Year" award in Britain.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ nii, nwadisawai ni (September 2018), o da paas nidib pisnu banɛ paasi kɛ ka London malis ka sʋŋi gɔs London dim bɛilim an si'em, bɛ Time Out dimi da diti ba yʋʋm pisnu la.
english: In September 2018, he was one of 50 people named for "making London awesome" and helping to shape London's cultural landscape, as part of Time Out's 50th anniversary.

english: His films have grossed over US$9.8 billion at the global box office, making him one of the top 20 highest-grossing actors.

english: Elba studied acting at the National Youth Music Theatre in London.

kusaal: Nidib len mi' o nɛ on da paasi maal di'ema ka ba buon o yʋ'ʋr anina ye Charles Miner bɛ NBC sitcom The Office yʋma tusa ayi nɛ awai (2009) la ni.
english: He is also known for his recurring guest role as Charles Miner in the NBC sitcom The Office (2009).

kusaal: O nɔk o kʋkɔr ma'a paas sininam ni ka ba si'eba an Zootopia, The Jungle Book, nɛ Finding Dory (all 2016).
english: He voiced Chief Bogo in Zootopia (2016), Zootopia+ (2022) and Zootopia 2 (2025), Shere Khan in The Jungle Book, Fluke in Finding Dory (both 2016), and Knuckles the Echidna in the Sonic the Hedgehog film series (2022–present), and played Man-At-Arms in Masters of the Universe (2026).

kusaal: Ka banɛ paas an Knuckles the Echidna nɛ Sonic the Hedgehog 2 (2022), Knuckles (2024), nɛ Sonic the Hedgehog 3 (2024).
english: He voiced Chief Bogo in Zootopia (2016), Zootopia+ (2022) and Zootopia 2 (2025), Shere Khan in The Jungle Book, Fluke in Finding Dory (both 2016), and Knuckles the Echidna in the Sonic the Hedgehog film series (2022–present), and played Man-At-Arms in Masters of the Universe (2026).

kusaal: O gaad tuoni gɔs sini si'eba nɛ Yardie (2018).
english: Elba made his directorial debut with Yardie (2018).

kusaal: Fʋ ya'a yis sini maalig, Elba mɛ lɛn anɛ DJ an DJ Big Driis bɛɛ Idris ka an R&B yʋmyʋm.
english: He also performs as a DJ under the moniker DJ Big Driis or Idris and as an R&B singer.

kusaal: Elba paas banɛ sʋ'ʋe Formula E team, Kiro Race Co.
english: He is a co-owner of the Formula E team, Kiro Race Co.

kusaal: O tʋm yʋ'ʋŋ di'ema zin'isin an DJ ka ba buon o ye "Big Driis" on da an dasaŋ la, ka yʋ'ʋn pin'ili ieed television ni tʋʋma o yʋʋm pisinam saŋa.
english: He worked in nightclubs under the DJ nickname "Big Driis" during his adolescence, but began auditioning for television roles in his early twenties.

english: He appeared as Charlie Gotso on The No. 1 Ladies' Detective Agency, filmed in Botswana.

english: In September 2009, he signed a deal to star as the lead role on the six-part BBC television series Luther, which aired in May 2010.

kusaal: O da paas Showtime's di'em kanɛ buon The Big C yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piiga (2010).
english: He appeared on Showtime's The Big C in 2010.

kusaal: One ti'al la da paam ligidi $29 million bakwai kanɛ ka li yina la.
english: The latter was a box office success, taking $29 million in its opening weekend.

kusaal: O mukir da kɛ ka ba gaŋ o bɛ Golden Globe Award for Best Actor – Motion Picture Drama.
english: His performance earned him a nomination for the Golden Globe Award for Best Actor – Motion Picture Drama.

kusaal: O da lɛn ti'ak o yʋ'ʋri lɛb Heimdall bɛ Thor: The Dark World yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ tan' (2013).
english: He reprised his role as Heimdall in Thor: The Dark World in 2013.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ naasi, pin'ilig nwadig la ni (January 2014), o da pa'al ye o na paasi maal sini kanɛ an Luther.
english: In January 2014, he confirmed that he would be starring in a film adaptation of Luther.

kusaal: Li da yi paalʋ na yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ wai, nwadisatan' dabpiinɛ nu daar (15 March 2019) ka da yisi li yʋʋm yinni nya'aŋ.
english: It premiered on 15 March 2019 and was cancelled after one season.

kusaal: O da maal sini kanɛ buon In the Long Run.
english: He also created and starred in the semi-autobiographical comedy In the Long Run.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ pisi nɛ nu, pin'ilig nwadis ni (January 2025), Idris Elba daa paasi maal sini pa'an nidibi la'asidi tʋm tʋʋmbɛ'ɛd si'em bɛ United Kingdom.
english: In January 2025, Idris Elba premiered a documentary into knife and gang-related crimes in the United Kingdom.

kusaal: O da yis o EP High Class Problems Vol.
english: He released his EP High Class Problems Vol. 1 in the United Kingdom in February 2010, for which he has won many prizes, including a Billboard Music Awards nomination.

kusaal: 1 paalʋ ni bɛ United Kingdom yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piiga, nwadsayi ni (February 2010), linzug ka o di'e piini bɛdigʋ, ka yinne an Billboard Music Awards nomination.
english: He released his EP High Class Problems Vol. 1 in the United Kingdom in February 2010, for which he has won many prizes, including a Billboard Music Awards nomination.

kusaal: Gbansɔbidib bama ayi nwa' tʋm tʋʋmkaŋa yʋma anaasi, bɔzʋgɔ, Elba da kɛŋi paae ba ye ba sʋŋ o ka o maal yʋʋma la, ka Allen-Martin mɛ da paasi li pʋʋgin.
english: The two writers had worked on the project for four years, following an approach from Elba asking them to develop his idea for a musical based on the album, on which Allen-Martin had also collaborated.

kusaal: Allen-Martin nɛ Henley da pa'al ye ba baŋir paasi li pʋʋgin bɔzʋgɔ, ba sɔb gbana, ka maal vɛɛnsa, banɛ lɛn pʋd di'ema la yʋ'ʋr, ka ban da yisi ba la, ba da ye ba ya'a yis di'ema la paalʋ na, ba na gban'e ba kootʋ ni.
english: Allen-Martin and Henley described their creative input as having included research and script-writing, as well as coming up with the play's title, and that after being removed, they were threatened with legal action if they went public with the story.

kusaal: Elba da paas "Boasty" yʋʋma sini ni, ka paas o kʋkɔr anina.
english: Elba also appears in the "Boasty" music video, delivering his verse in a mansion that includes a film set.

kusaal: Elba da lɛn la'as nɛ Paul McCartney ka ba yʋʋm yʋmkanɛ buon "Long Tailed Winter Bird" la.
english: Elba also collaborated with Paul McCartney on a remix of his song "Long Tailed Winter Bird".

kusaal: Phantom Liberty dimi da yis zin'ig kanɛ ka fʋ na nyaŋi paam CD Projekt Red yʋʋm tusayi nɛ pisi (2020) sini di'ema kanɛ buon Cyberpunk 2077, walisnam ayi, bababa tan' la pʋʋgin da paas Elba.
english: With the release of the Phantom Liberty downloadable expansion for CD Projekt Red's 2020 video game Cyberpunk 2077, two of three new radio stations introduced feature Elba.

kusaal: O da pin'il sɔnsig nɛ Canada dim pʋ'a kanɛ na kpikpinkpiŋ ka o yʋ'ʋr buon Sabrina Dhowre yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ yɔpɔi pin'ilig ni (2017).
english: He began a relationship with Canadian model and businesswoman Sabrina Dhowre in early 2017.

kusaal: Ba da la'as taaba yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ nii, nwadisayi, dabpiiga daar (10 February 2018), on da maal o sini kanɛ buon Yardie bɛ East London sini zin'igin la, ka di taaba yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛwai, nwadisanaasi, dabpisi nɛ ayuobʋ daar (26 April 2019) bɛ Marrakesh.
english: They became engaged on 10 February 2018, during a screening of his film Yardie at an East London cinema, and were married on 26 April 2019 in Marrakesh.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ piinɛ yuobʋ, pin'ilig nwadig la ni (January 2016), Elba da si'al UK parliament ka pian'a pa'ali ba sini la an si'em.
english: In January 2016, Elba addressed the UK parliament regarding the concern of the lack of diversity on screen.

kusaal: Elba sʋ'ʋe sʋŋir si'a, Elba Hope Foundation mɛ da paasi li pʋʋgin, ka ban bɔɔdim anɛ ye ba gu' ka nidib ka ba da kuosid sʋ'ʋs na'asaasɔɔnginɛ, ka kɛ ka wada kpi'ami tis zaba la'ad da'ab.
english: Elba's Elba Hope Foundation was part of this coalition, which was also focusing on restricting online knife sales and tightening regulations on dangerous weapons.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ pisi nɛ nu, pin'ilig nwadig la (January 2025), o da pa'al ye on bas ni'im ɔnbir nwadisayuobʋ ni.
english: In January 2025, he revealed that he had stopped eating meat around six months prior.

english: He joined the New Patriotic Party and was a member of President Kufour's government as a District Chief Executive of the Sunyani District Assembly.

english: He later became the deputy regional minister for the Brong-Ahafo region and subsequently became the regional minister under the same Kuffour administration.
