english: Kwabena Twum-Nuamah (born 17 January 1978) is a Ghanaian politician and medical doctor.

kusaal: Onɛ lɛn an kʋkdaan n tis wadmaanib yir kpɛɛm banɛ gɔsid nimma'asim yɛla la ka lɛn an Finance Committee nid yinnɛ ya'as.
english: He is also the chairperson for the Parliamentary Select Committee on Health and a member of the Finance Committee.

kusaal: Ba da dua Kwabena Twum-Nuamah bɛnɛ Berekum Ghana nwa ni yʋʋm tusir nɛ kɔbiswai nɛ pisyɔpɔi nɛ anii (1978).
english: Twum-Nuamah was born in 1978 at Berekum, Ghana.

kusaal: O mɛ anɛ niŋ kanɛ ka ba gaŋ ye o an Parliamentary Committee ligidi gɔsigʋn.
english: He is also a member of the Parliamentary Select Committee on Finance.

kusaal: Twum-Nuamah mɔr pʋ'a nɛ biisa atan'.
english: Twum-Nuamah is married (with three children).

kusaal: Francisca Oteng-Mensah an wadmaan nananna tis constituency la.
english: Onyina-Acheampong Akwasi Gyamfi is the member of parliament for the constituency.

kusaal: Oboafo Kwadjo Asante (born June 21, 1977) anɛ Gaana pɔlitiks nwɛ'ɛd nɛ onɛ kpiisid.
english: Oboafo Kwadjo Asante (born June 21, 1977) is a Ghanaian politician and businessman.

kusaal: O yinɛ Akropong Akuapem n bɛ Eastern Region sʋ'ʋlim, Ghana.
english: He hails from Akropong Akuapem in the Eastern Region of Ghana.

kusaal: Oboafo mɔr bachelor in education degree in Science (Chemistry), diploma in science education, a Post Graduate Diploma in Business Analytics (PGDBA) nɛ Master of Business Administration (Finance).
english: Oboafo' has a bachelor in education degree in Science (Chemistry), a diploma in science education, a Post Graduate Diploma in Business Analytics (PGDBA) and a Master of Business Administration (Finance).

kusaal: Oboafo Kwadjo anɛ kpɛɛm tita'ar (managing director) tis Kay and Moby Company Limited.
english: Oboafo Kwadjo is the managing director of Kay and Moby Company Limited.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusa ayi nɛ pisi (2020) ka o da zi'en wabʋg na'adɔɔg la (NPP) nɔba zugʋ nya' Suhum bɛ Eastern Region sʋ'ʋlim, Ghana.
english: In 2020 he contested and won the NPP parliamentary primaries for Suhum (Ghana parliament constituency) in the Eastern Region of Ghana.

kusaal: O da paas la'askanɛ gɔsid fuud dim yɛla la (Defence and Interior Committee) wadmaanib yin la.
english: He serves as a member of the Defence and Interior Committee of parliament.

kusaal: O anɛ wadmaan tis Suhum sʋ'ʋlim.
english: He was the Member of parliament for the Suhum (Ghana parliament constituency) between January 2021 and January 2025.

kusaal: Ba da du'a Oboafo nɛ yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛpisyɔpɔi nɛ ayɔpɔi la nwadisi ayuobʋ la dabpisi nɛ yinne daar (June 21, 1977).
english: Oboafo was born on June 21, 1977.

kusaal: O da di kʋk la yʋʋm tusa ayi nɛ pisi (2020) Gaana gil vɔɔtʋg la.
english: He won the parliamentary seat in the 2020 Ghanaian general election beating the National Democratic Congress (Ghana)'s Amanda Okyere Kwatia.

kusaal: Oboafo anɛ Kristo biig.
english: Oboafo is a Christian.

kusaal: O anɛ Ma'asim tiig Na'adɔɔg la, National Democratic Congress.
english: He represented the Biakoye Constituency in the Oti Region on the ticket of the National Democratic Congress.

kusaal: Aboagye yinɛ Apesokubi.
english: Aboagye hails from Apesokubi.

kusaal: O mɔr B.S.C in Civil Engineering yi Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, corporate governance kasɛtta gbaʋŋ yi GIMPA.
english: He holds a B.S.C in Civil Engineering from the Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, a certificate in corporate governance from GIMPA.

kusaal: O lɛn paas Ghana Institute of Engineers nɛ Civil Institution of Engineers bɛ U.K la.
english: He is also a member of the Ghana Institute of Engineers and the Civil Institution of Engineers, U.K.

kusaal: Kwadwo Nyanpon Aboagye anɛ Gaanapɔlitiks nwɛ'ɛd ka paas Wadmaanib yikanɛ paasi ayɔpɔi Gaana Republic kanɛ paasi annaasi la ni tis Biakoye Constituency bɛ Oti Region la sʋ'ʋlim dim.
english: Kwadwo Nyanpon Aboagye (born 13 November 1950) is a Ghanaian politician and a former member of the Seventh and Eighth Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusa ayi nɛ pisi nɛ ay la Nwadisa anaasi la ni (April 2022), o da kɛya ka ba maal nini ɔɔnlʋg nɛ ti'ebʋg zaalim tis Biakoye sʋ'ʋlim dim zaalim.
english: In April 2022, he organized a free eye screening and surgery for the residents of Biakoye.

kusaal: ka ti Ghana Gɔmina Nana Addo Danquah Akuffo-Addo da gaŋ o ka wadmaanib banɛ bɛ wadmaanib yir la wυsa da siaki tis o.
english: He was appointed by President Nana Addo Danquah Akuffo-Addo in January 2017 and was approved by the Members of Parliament in February 2017.

kusaal: O da keŋ sakur naae University of Ghana mɔr kasɛta gbaυŋ linɛ an MB CBH n zamisi linɛ an laafi bɛɛ nimma'asim yɛla ka lɛn tɔlisi keŋ Tulane University linɛ bɛ New Orleans, U.S. la di'e kasɛta gbaυŋ linɛ an Master of Public Health.
english: He has an MB CBH from the University of Ghana Medical School and a Master of Public Health from Tulane University, New Orleans, United States.

kusaal: Kwaku Afriyie anɛ Ghana pɔlitis nwɛ'ɛd, o anɛ kpaad ka an Wabυg Na'adɔɔg nid.
english: Kwaku Afriyie (born 7 July 1954) is a Ghanaian politician, farmer and a member of the New Patriotic Party in Ghana.

kusaal: Onɛ da an Minista tis Ghana Western Region sυ'υlυm la lin da yi yυυma tusa ayi' nɛ pii nɛ ayɔpɔi n ti paae yυυm tusa ayi' nɛ pii nɛ nii la ni.
english: He was a member of Parliament for Sefwi Wiawso constituency in the Western North Region of Ghana in the 7th and Eighth Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana.

kusaal: Ba du'a Kwaku Afriyie nɛ Burnya nya'aŋ nwaris ayɔpɔi la li daba ayɔpɔi daar yυυm tυsir nɛ kɔbiswai nɛ piisnu nɛ anaasi la ni.
english: Kwaku Afriyie was born on 7 July 1954, at Sefwi Wiawso, Ghana.

kusaal: O da Ghana du'atanam banɛ tυm laarisυg tυυma la ni.
english: He was also a fellow of the Ghana College of Physicians and Surgeons.

kusaal: Kwaku Agyemang-Manu (du'am; senlʋŋ nwadig 6, 1955) anɛ Ghana pɔlitis nwɛ'ɛd.
english: Kwaku Agyemang-Manu (born September 6, 1955) a Ghanaian politician.

kusaal: O anɛ Chartered Management Accountant ka maal o Bachelor of Arts in Economics and Statistics kasɛta gbaʋŋ yit University of Ghana yʋʋm tusir nɛ kɔbiswai nɛ pisnii nɛ awai (1989) la ni.
english: He is a Chartered Management Accountant and obtained a Bachelor of Arts in Economics and Statistics from the University of Ghana in 1989.

kusaal: Ba da du'a Agyeman-Manu bɛnɛ Dormaa Ahenkro teŋkanɛ bɛ Brong Ahafo Region zin'ikanɛ yʋ'ʋn an Bono Region la.
english: Agyeman-Manu was born in Dormaa Ahenkro in the then Brong Ahafo Region, now Bono Region.

kusaal: O da maali o G.C.E Ordinary Level nɛ yʋʋm tusir nɛ kɔbiswai nɛ pisyɔpɔi nɛ atan' la mi (1973), ka maali o G.C.E Advanced Level yʋʋm tusir nɛ kɔbiswai nɛ pisyɔpɔi nɛ anu (1975) la ni.
english: He had his G.C.E Ordinary Level in 1973 and his G.C.E Advanced Level in 1975.

kusaal: O anɛ Chartered Management Accountant ka an Associate Member yʋʋm tusir nɛ kɔbiswai nɛ piswai (1990) la ni.
english: He became a Chartered Management Accountant and Associate Member in 1990.

kusaal: Ka da maali o Bachelor of Arts in Economics nɛ Statistics yit University of Ghana yʋʋm tusir nɛ kɔbiswai nɛ pisyɔpɔi nɛ awai (1979) la ni.
english: He obtained a Bachelor of Arts in Economics and Statistics from the University of Ghana in 1979.

kusaal: O da lɛn maal Management Accountancy London School of Accountancy la ni.
english: He also graduated with Management Accountancy from the London School of Accountancy.

kusaal: O da anɛ Director of finance tis Ghamot Company Limited kanɛ bɛ Toyota Ghana Company Limited ni la.
english: He was the Director of finance at the Ghamot Company Limited and also at Toyota Ghana Company Limited.

kusaal: O da lɛn anɛ Deputy Chief Accountant tis MIM Timber Company Limited.
english: He was also the Deputy Chief Accountant at the MIM Timber Company Limited.

kusaal: Gɔmena kaŋa ni, o da anɛ Deputy Minister of State tis Trade and Industry nɛ Interior nɛ Finance nɛ labaya tʋʋma nɛ Roads and Transport.
english: In this government, he served a Deputy Minister of State in the following Ministries: Trade and Industry, Interior, Finance, Communication and Roads and Transport.

kusaal: O da lɛn tʋm Boards of institutions nwɛnɛ bama ni Small Arms Commission of Ghana, the Ghana Revenue Authority, Bank of Ghana, and the Divestiture Implementation Committee.
english: He has served on the Boards of institutions such as the Small Arms Commission of Ghana, the Ghana Revenue Authority, Bank of Ghana, and the Divestiture Implementation Committee.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusa ayi' nɛ pii nɛ ayɔpɔi la li nwdisa anu ni, 2017, Pirɛsidɛn Nana Akufo-Addo da gaŋ Kwaku Agyemang-Manu ye o paasi o ministanam pii nɛ awai banɛ na sʋn o ka o tʋm la.
english: In May 2017, President Nana Akufo-Addo named Kwaku Agyemang-Manu as part of nineteen ministers who would form his cabinet.

kusaal: On da an Cabinet Minista la, Agyemang-Manu da paas nimbanɛ pʋ lal nɛ Pirɛsidɛn la ka sʋŋidi gban'ad gban'abanɛ na sʋŋ ka teŋ la keŋ tuon.
english: As a Cabinet Minister, Agyemang-Manu is part of the inner circle of the President and aids in key decision-making policies for the country.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusa ayi' nɛ anu la ni la (2005), Kwaku Agyemang Manu, da an Deputy Finance Minister Kufuor saŋa la, o minista kpɛɛm da kae ka o yis gbaʋŋʋ tis Minister of Finance to a company kanɛ ka Alfred Agbesi Woyome sʋ'oe ye ba mɛ stadia's CAN yʋʋm 2008 la yɛla.
english: In 2005, Mr. Kwaku Agyemang Manu, then Deputy Finance Minister under the Kufuor administration, issued a letter in the absence of the substantive Minister of Finance to a company owned by Mr. Alfred Agbesi Woyome in regards to the construction of stadia's for the CAN 2008.

kusaal: Woyome da mɔr Ghana Gɔmina keŋ kɔɔtʋ yʋʋm tusa ayi' nɛ awai la (2009) ka ba da kad o saria ka o di bʋʋd ka ba yɔɔ o Ghana siidi milinyɔŋ pisnu nɛ yinne (GHC 51 million), ka di yinɛ gbaʋŋ kanɛ ka Kwaku Agyemang Manu da sɔb la yɛla.
english: Mr. Woyome then sued the Government of Ghana in 2009 and secured a judgment of over GHC 51 million, relying on the letter issued by Mr. Kwaku Agyemang Manu.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusa ayi' nɛ pii nɛ awai la Nwadisa ayi' la daba anii daar (8 fuluŋfuk nwadig 2019), Pirɛsidɛn tis IMANI Center for Policy & Education, a Ghanaian-based Think Tank, da yina yɛl ye Nima'asim lʋgir dim la ye ba (MoH) pʋ dɔl suokanɛ nar ye ba dɔl ka da' Wiidi tiim la, o da sɔbnɛ gbaʋŋ nyain tis Minista la dɔlis Na'asaasɔɔng suokanɛ yʋ'ʋri an Facebook la.
english: On the 8 February 2019 the President of IMANI Center for Policy & Education, a Ghanaian-based Think Tank, first reported about various procurement breaches by the Ministry of Health (MoH) in the procurement of Anti-Snake Venom Serum in an open letter on Facebook to the Minister.

kusaal: Public Procurement Authority (PPA) da vɛɛns ya ka zɛrig minista la bɛdigʋ ka pa'al ye o mɔr gbɛlima bɛdigʋ ka sɔb gbaʋŋʋ tis Ministry ye ba yiisim o tis Pharmanova company nam ayi' la ka vɛɛnsbanɛ kpɛlim la ka ba gɔs.yɛlkaŋa da tiig zin'ig la wʋsa ka di lidig nidib bɛdigʋ nɛ minista la nam bɛ tʋʋma ni ka pʋ sig la.
english: The Public Procurement Authority (PPA) ruled against the Ministry and cited various procurement breaches in its decision and requested the Ministry to disqualify the two Pharmanova companies for double bidding amongst other issues and re-evaluate the tender with the remaining tenderers.

kusaal: Hali ken paae yʋʋm tusa ayi' nɛ pisi la Nwadisa atan' la ni, Minista la da mɔ suoya bɛdigʋ ye o gu'oe zin'ikan ka tiak wiidi tikanɛ an Anti-Snake Venom Serum la, ka pʋ kɛlig ye PPA hali ka lɛn mɔɔd ye o kɛ ka di dɔlis Pharmanova Ghana Limited ya'as.
english: Up until March 2020, the Minister has tried various attempts to cancel the said tender, opened up new tenders for Anti-Snake Venom Serum, ignoring the ruling by the PPA and trying to allocate these new tenders again to Pharmanova Ghana Limited.

kusaal: Company kanɛ bɛ Ghana ka Indian dim sʋ'oe ka dɔribidi di.
english: A locally registered company owned and managed by Indian nationals has been active in Ghana since 2005 and has increasingly won many tenders especially under the tenure of Kwaku Agyemang Manu as the Minister of Health.

kusaal: Ba da buol Girimadaan Kwaku Agyeman-Manu ye kena paas executive board of the World Health Organization (WHO) zi'eni tis Gaana.
english: Hon. Kwaku Agyeman-Manu has been called to serve on the executive board of the World Health Organization (WHO) as the representative of Ghana who is a member state of the WHO.It is to note that WHO elects its members from their Member States only.

kusaal: Agyeman-Manu paas ninsabilis tɛɛnsa ayɔpɔi banɛ da zi'eni ba teŋ yɛla paas executive board of WHO yʋʋm tusa ayi nɛ pisi Nwadisa anu la ni (May 2020).
english: Mr. Agyeman-Manu joins in as one of the seven Africans who represent their countries to support the executive board of WHO in May 2020.

kusaal: O anɛ Wadmaan tis Dormaa Central Constituency ka an Minista kanɛ gɔsid nimma'asim lʋgʋr la.
english: Agyeman-Manu is a member of the New Patriotic Party and the member of parliament for Dormaa Central Constituency in the then Brong Ahafo region of Ghana.

kusaal: Agyeman-Manu anɛ Wabʋg Na'adɔɔg la nid ka an Wadmaan tis Dormaa Central Constituency kanɛ bɛ Brong Ahafo region sʋ'ʋlimin, Ghana nwa la O da anɛ kʋkdaani tis Public Accounts Committee Wadmaanib yikanɛ paasi ayɔpɔi la ni, o da lɛn anɛ acting CEO tisi A-nwaae-da' gu' waad lʋgir la yʋʋm tusa ayi' nɛ ayuobʋ (2006) la ni, ka lɛn an deputy Minister of Finance and Economic Planning Pirɛsidɛn kʋdʋg Kufuor yʋʋm saŋa kanɛ da an yʋʋm tusa ayi' nɛ yinne ti paae yʋʋm tusa ayi' nɛ anii la ni la (2001 to 2008).
english: He served as the Chairman of the Public Accounts Committee in the immediate-past Parliament and was the acting CEO of the National Health Authority in 2006, and also the deputy Minister of Finance and Economic Planning under former President Kufuor's administration (2001 to 2008).

kusaal: Lɛbisʋg la da paae IMANI on yɛl si'em la.
english: A follow-up response was also sent to IMANI in this regard.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusa ayi' nɛ pii nɛ awai la ni,2019, nimma'asim lʋgʋr la da yɔ'ɔg suor ye ba da' kondonnam ka lidigir la anɛ ye Ghana tikuosidib sɔ' da pʋ paasɛ ka di kɛ ka nidib bu'osid bu'osa ye ba sid mɔɔl ya nwɛnnɛ Public Procurement Act la yɛl si'em laa.
english: Interestingly, no local company who could have supplied the condoms participated, raising questions if the tender was open and widely publicized as required by the Public Procurement Act.

kusaal: Lidigir la anɛ ye tʋʋma la da lɛn keŋ li Pharmanova Limited nu'usin ya'as.
english: It is also interesting to note that the contract again went to Pharmanova Limited.

kusaal: Kwaku Agyemang Manu da an Minista tis nimma'asim lʋgʋr la company kaŋ a da maan si'el wʋsa tisid Ghana.
english: A locally registered company owned and managed by Indian nationals has been active in Ghana since 2005 and has increasingly won many tenders especially under the tenure of Kwaku Agyemang Manu as the Minister of Health.

kusaal: Di nar ka ti baŋ ye WHO gaansidi ba nidibnɛ tembanɛ paasi di pʋʋgin ka on an Ghana nimma'asim lʋgʋr minister la, o zi'enɛ Gaana nɔba zug ka ka' o mɛŋa.
english: Hon. Kwaku Agyeman-Manu has been called to serve on the executive board of the World Health Organization (WHO) as the representative of Ghana who is a member state of the WHO.It is to note that WHO elects its members from their Member States only.

kusaal: O mɔr pʋ'a nɛ biisi ayuobʋ.
english: He is married and has six known children.

kusaal: Kwaku Agyenim-Boateng (ba da du'a o nɛ 1 sapal nwadig 1972) anɛ Ghana pɔlitis nwɛ'ɛd ka an wadmaani paas Wadmaanib yikanɛ paasi ayɔpɔi la Ghana republickanɛ paas anaasi la ni tis Berekum West constituency bɛ Brong-Ahafo Region la Wabʋg Na'adɔɔg, nɔba zug.
english: Kwaku Agyenim-Boateng (born 1 November 1972) is a Ghanaian politician and served as a member of the Eighth Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana representing the Berekum West constituency in the Bono Region on the ticket of the New Patriotic Party.

kusaal: O da maali o Bachelor of Science degree in Planning kasɛta gbaʋŋ yit Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology ni yʋʋm tusir nɛ kɔbiswai nɛ piswai nɛ ayɔpɔi la ni (1997).
english: He obtained his Bachelor of Science degree in Planning from Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology in 1997.

kusaal: Ka maali o Mastɛs of Science in Public Policy and Management kasɛta gbaʋŋ yit University of London yʋʋm tusa ayi' nɛ anii la ni (2008).
english: He pursued his Masters of Science in Public Policy and Management at the University of London in 2008.

kusaal: O lɛn mɔr wada kasɛta gbaʋŋ yit Anglia Ruskin University, bɛ UK la yʋʋm tusa ayi' nɛ anaasi ni (2004) nɛ L.L.B. (GIMPA) yʋʋm tusa ayi' nɛ pii nɛ anaasi (2014).
english: He also holds a Post Graduate Certificate in Law from the Anglia Ruskin University, in UK 2004 and L.L.B. (GIMPA) in 2014.

kusaal: Ba da dʋ'a Boatengnɛ nɛ yʋʋm tusir nɛ kɔbiswai nɛ pisyɔpɔi nɛ ayi' Nwadispiinɛ yinne yiiga daar (1 sapal nwadig 1972), tenkanɛ yʋ'ʋri an Jinijini bɛ Bono Region dinɛ an Brong Ahafo Region sʋ'ʋlʋm .
english: Boateng was born on 1 November 1972, in the town of Jinijini in the Bono Region, then Brong Ahafo Region.

kusaal: Boateng anɛ Wabʋg Na'adɔɔg (NPP) nid.
english: Boateng is a member of the New Patriotic Party (NPP).

kusaal: Yiiga ka ba vɔɔti tis o yʋʋm tusa ayi' nɛ awai yʋʋmpaal Nwadig la ni (yʋʋmpaal nwadig 2009) la, onɛ da di yʋʋm tusa ayi' nɛ anii (2008) Ghana dim wʋsa vɔɔtʋg la.
english: He was first elected into Parliament in January 2009 after he emerged winner in the 2008 Ghanaian General Election.

kusaal: Ba da lɛn vɔɔt gaŋ o ya'as ka o paas wadmaanib yikanɛ paasi ayuobʋ (6th) nɛ ayɔpɔi la (7th).
english: He was then re-elected into the 6th and 7th Parliament.

kusaal: O da diya nɛ vɔɔt pisnu nɛ ayuobʋ du'al pistan' nɛ atan' ka kɔbʋg pʋʋgin ka li an 56.33% vɔɔt la wʋsa pʋʋgin yʋʋm tusa ayi' nɛ pii nɛ ayuobʋ (2016) Ghana wʋsa vɔɔtʋg la nya'aŋ.
english: He defeated his opposition with 56.33% of the total valid votes after the 2016 Ghanaian general election.

kusaal: O da lɛn di yʋʋm tusa ayi' nɛ pisi (2020) Ghana wʋsa vɔɔtʋg la nɛ vɔɔt tusa pii nɛ yinne nɛ kɔbisyi' nɛ pisnaasi nɛ anu (11,245) ka li an pisnaasi nɛ ayɔpɔi kɔbʋg pʋʋgin (47%), ka NDC nid Dickson Kyere-Duah paam vɔɔt tusa piiga nɛ kɔbisyi' nɛ piswai nɛ ayuobʋ (10,296) ka li an pisnaasi nɛ atan' kɔbʋg pʋʋgin (43%) ka Derrick Obeng Mensah onɛ zi'e o nyadi la mɛ mɔr vɔɔt kal tusa ayi nɛ kɔbistan' nɛ piswai nɛ anu (2,395) ka li an piiga kɔbʋg pʋʋgin (10%).
english: He again won the 2020 Ghanaian general elections with 11,245 votes making 47% of the total votes cast whilst the NDC parliamentary candidate Dickson Kyere-Duah had 10,296 votes making 43% of the total votes cast and an Independent candidate Derrick Obeng Mensah had 2,395 votes making 10% of the total votes cast.

kusaal: O anɛ Deputy Minista kʋdʋg tis Railways Development.
english: He was the former Deputy Minister for Railways Development.

kusaal: O paasnɛ la'askanɛ gɔsid Employment, Social Welfare and State Enterprises Committee nɛ Poverty Reduction Strategy Committee.
english: He is a member of the Employment, Social Welfare and State Enterprises Committee and also a member of the Poverty Reduction Strategy Committee.

kusaal: Boateng da anɛ development planner nɛ Legal Service Consultant din yi yʋʋm tusir nɛ kɔbiswai nɛ piswai nɛ anii (1998) ti paae yʋʋm tusa ayi' nɛ anii la ni (2008).
english: Boateng worked as a development planner and a Legal Service Consultant from1998 to 2008.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusa ayi' nɛ pisi la li Yʋʋmpaal Nwadig la ni (yʋʋmpaal nwadig 2020), o da yɔ'ɔg pu'adu'as dɔɔg ka ba pin'il tʋʋma ka lɛn nɔk nimma'asim tʋʋma la'adi tis Nkyekyemamu Health Center bɛ Berekum West District la.
english: In January 2020, he commissioned a maternity ward and donated medical items for the Nkyekyemamu Health Center in the Berekum West District.

kusaal: O da tisi ba Sibiti gat ban piiga (hospital beds) nɛ machine banɛ ka ba mɔri nɔkir nidib tɛbisim la nɛ kʋkʋs nɛ television nɛ banɛ bɛ wʋsa n tis Amankwokwa Community-based Health Planning and Services.
english: He also presented hospital beds, weighing machine, office chairs, television etc to Amankwokwa Community-based Health Planning and Services.

kusaal: Boateng anɛ Kristo biig.
english: Boateng is a Christian.

kusaal: O zi'enɛ tis Mampong Constituency linɛ bɛ Ashanti Region la, wabʋg paati (NPP).Nannana o anɛ Minista nya'andɔli tis Minista onɛ gɔsid Tenzʋna yɛla nɛ onɛ sʋ'ʋŋid ye Tenzʋna Maal Nɔɔryinne la (Deputy Minister tit Foreign Affairs nɛ Regional Integration).
english: He is currently the Deputy Minister for Foreign Affairs and Regional Integration.

kusaal: Kwaku Ampratwum-Sarpong, ba da du'a o nɛ Yʋʋmpaal Nwadig la daba anii daar 8 yʋʋm tusir nɛ kɔbiswai nɛ pisnu na anii 1958, ka yit Mampong teŋkanɛ bɛ, Ashanti Region sʋ'ʋlʋm la.
english: Kwaku Ampratwum-Sarpong was born on January 8, 1958, in Mampong in the Ashanti Region.

kusaal: O mɔri Diploma kasɛta gbauŋ tis Housing Management yit University of Westminster, London.
english: He holds a post graduate diploma in Housing Management from the University of Westminster, London.

kusaal: O da lɛn keŋ university of Ghana n zamisi di'e B.A.(Hons) digirii kasɛta gbaʋŋ.
english: He underwent his undergraduate studies at the University of Ghana where he attained a B.A.(Hons) Degree.

kusaal: O mɛ da lɛn dɛŋi paam kpɛʋŋ kasɛta gbaʋŋ yit Graduate School of Governance nɛ Leadership Accra, Ghana.
english: He also has an advanced executive certificate from the Graduate School of Governance and Leadership in Accra, Ghana.

kusaal: Ampratwum-Sarpong lɛn anɛ kpɛɛm Yinne tis Charted Institute of Housing nɛ Institute of Directors linɛ bɛ United Kingdom la.
english: Ampratwum-Sarpong is also an associate member of the Chartered Institute of Housing and the Institute of Directors in the United Kingdom.

kusaal: Mohammed Kojo Aboasu Onɛ an NDC nid Rebecca Otum onɛ an PPP nid nɛ Osei Kofi Edward Adepa onɛ an UFP nid la nɛ Ahmed Ibrahim Saleh onɛ PNC nid la nɛ Christopher Adansi Bona onɛ an CPP nid nɛ Richmond Akuoko onɛ an GCPP paati nid banɛ da li'ad na'am la.
english: Mohammed Kojo Aboasu of National Democratic Congress, Rebecca Otum of People's Patriotic Party, Osei Kofi Edward Adepa of United Front Party, Ahmed Ibraham Saleh of People's National Convention, Christopher Adansi Bona of Convention People's Party, and Richmond Akuoko of Great Consolidated People's Party were the other aspirants.

kusaal: O da lɛn di ya'as yʋʋm 2020 vɔɔdʋg la ni tis Mampong sʋ'ʋlʋm la.
english: He again won the parliamentary seat for the Mampong Constituency during the 2020 elections with 36,159 votes making 69.8% of the valid votes cast.

kusaal: O anɛ Trade, Industry nɛ Tourism Committee nid nɛ Special Budget Committee nid.
english: He is a member of the Trade, Industry and Tourism Committee and also a member of the Special Budget Committee.

kusaal: Kwaku Ampratwum-Sarpong da anɛ Deputy High Commissioner tis Ghana's Foreign Affairs Minister la lin yi yʋʋm 2006 ti paae yʋʋm 2009 ka lɛn an Executive Director tis Ghana-India Business Network, Accra.
english: Kwaku Ampratwum-Sarpong was the Deputy High Commissioner to Ghana's Foreign Affairs Ministry from 2006 to 2009 and also the executive director of the Ghana-India Business Network, Accra.

kusaal: O anɛ Vice Chairman tis Foreign Affairs Committee la wadmaanib yit la ni.
english: He is the Vice Chairman of the Foreign Affairs Committee in Parliament.

kusaal: Yiiga ka o kpɛn' Politis nwɛ'ɛb la, Ampratwum-Sarpong da anɛ Divisional Service Manager bɛ Hanover Hackney Ltd ni, UK lin yi yʋʋm 2002 ti paae yʋʋm 2005.
english: Before his move into politics, Ampratwum-Sarpong was the divisional service manager at Hanover in Hackney Ltd, UK from 2002 to 2005.

kusaal: Lin yi yʋʋm 1991 ti paae yʋʋm 2002 la London Brough of Hackney sʋ'ʋlim, UK, o da lɛn anɛ divisional service manager.
english: From 1991 to 2002 at the London Brough of Hackney, UK, he was also the divisional service manager.

kusaal: Lin yi yʋʋm 1990 ti paae yʋʋm 1991 o da anɛ senior administration officer bɛ London Brough of Lambert, UK.
english: From 1990 to 1991 he was the senior administration officer at the London Brough of Lambeth, UK.

kusaal: O anɛ Nwabʋg paati la nid (NPP) nɛ wadmaanib yir nidi tis Mampong constituency la.
english: He is a member of the New Patriotic Party and the member of parliament for the Mampong Constituency.

kusaal: Kwaku Ampratwum-Sarpong anɛ Yesu Pʋ'ʋsʋm nid.O nɔŋi zimi gban'ab nɛ Bɔɔl nwɛ'ɛb nɛ karʋŋ nɛ yʋʋma kɛlisʋg.
english: Kwaku Ampratwum-Sarpong identifies as a Christian.

kusaal: O mɔr pu'a nɛ biis atan'.
english: He is married with three children.

kusaal: Kwaku Asante-Boateng (Ba da du'a o nɛ 27 vaala nwadig 1961) anɛ Ghana Pɔlitis nwɛ'ɛd ka paas seventh Parliament nid of the Fourth Republic la ni, zi'eni tis Asante-Akim South Constituency bɛ Ashanti Region linɛ an Wabʋg paati la.
english: Kwaku Asante-Boateng (born 27 April 1961) is a Ghanaian politician and member of the Seventh Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana and the 8th Parliament of the Fourth Republic, representing the Asante-Akim South Constituency in the Ashanti Region on the ticket of the New Patriotic Party.

kusaal: Ba da du'a Asante-Boateng nɛ 27 vaala nwadig la 1961n bɛ Bompata sʋ'ʋlim, Asante Akim, Ghana.
english: Asante-Boateng was born on 27 April 1961 in Bompata, Asante Akim of Ghana.

kusaal: Asante-Boateng da mɔri Bachelor of science digirii land economy ni yit Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology la.
english: Asante-Boateng earned a Bachelor of Science degree in land economy at Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology.

kusaal: O da lɛn mɔr Project Planning and management kasɛta gbaʋŋ n yit GIMPA.
english: He also earned a certificate in project planning and management at GIMPA.

kusaal: O da mɔr MBA kasɛta gbaʋŋ n yit University of Ghana, Legon.
english: He obtained his MBA at University of Ghana, Legon.

kusaal: O da mɔr Diploma in Licensed surveyor kasɛta gbaʋŋ linɛ an Ghana Institute of Survey la.
english: He earned a diploma in Licensed Surveyor at Ghana institute of survey.

kusaal: Asante-Boateng da anɛ Lɔya ka an CEO kanɛ gɔsid Property Solution Models nɛ Real Concept R. Limited Accra wʋsa.
english: Asante-Boateng was a lawyer and CEO of Property Solution Models and Real Concepts R. Limited both in Accra.

kusaal: O da lieb EST officer tis Assistant manager of state insurance company of Ghana lin yi yʋʋm tusir nɛ kɔbiswai nɛ piswai nɛ yinne la ti paae yʋʋm tusa ayi' la ni.
english: He became EST officer to the assistant manager of State Insurance Company of Ghana from 1991 to 2000.

kusaal: O da anɛ project nɛ estate manager bɛ Unilever Ghana Limited lin yi yʋʋm tusa ayi' ti paae yʋʋm tusa ayi' nɛ anaasi la ni.
english: He was projects and estate manager at Unilever Ghana Limited from 2000 to 2004.

kusaal: Asante-Boateng da anɛ majority nid Yinne 6th Parliament of the 4th republic of Ghana la.
english: Asante-Boateng was a majority member of the 6th parliament of the 4th republic of Ghana.

kusaal: Nananna, o anɛ kpɛɛm kanɛ gɔsid Railway Development la nya'andɔl .
english: Currently, he is the Deputy Minister for Railway Development.

kusaal: Asante-Boateng anɛ Subsidiary Legislation Committee nid nɛ Government Assurance Committee nid ka an Employment nɛ Social Welfare nɛ State Enterprise Committee nid.
english: Asante-Boateng is a member of the Subsidiary Legislation Committee, a member of the Government Assurance Committee, and a member of the Employment, Social Welfare and State Enterprises Committee.

kusaal: Kwaku Asante-Boateng anɛ Yesu pʋ'ʋsʋm nid ka ken Assemblies of God Pʋ'ʋsʋm la.
english: Kwaku Asante-Boateng is a Christian and attends Assemblies of God.

kusaal: O da kena lieb Wadman Ghana wada sakurin la.
english: He became a barrister at law at the Ghana School of Law.

kusaal: O da anɛ Assistant Valuer bɛ Land valuation division la lin yi yʋʋm tusir nɛ kɔbiswai nɛ pisnii nɛ awai ti paae yʋʋm tusir nɛ kɔbiswai nɛ piswai nɛ yinne la ni.
english: He was the assistant valuer at the land valuation division from 1989 to 1991.

kusaal: O da kena an kpɛɛm tita'ar kanɛ gɔsid private real estate company la yʋʋm tusa ayi' nɛ anaasi la ni.
english: He became the chief executive officer of a private real estate company in 2004.

kusaal: O anɛ wabʋg na'adɔɔg la nid ka an wadmaanib yir nid n tis Asante Akim South Constituency kʋk la.
english: He is a member of the NPP and a member of parliament for the Asante Akim South Constituency.

kusaal: O mɔr Pu'a nɛ biis anaasi.
english: He is married with four children.

kusaal: Kwaku Agyemang Kwarteng anɛ Ghana pɔlitis nwɛ'ɛd, ba da du'a nɛ Burnya nwaris ayi' la li dabisim pii nɛ ayi' daar yυυm tusir nɛ kɔbisiwai nɛ pisyuobʋ nɛ awai la ni O zin'inɛ Obuasi West linɛ bɛ Ashanti Region Ghana sυ'υlυm la wadmaanib kυk la zug nɔɔr ayi'.
english: He is a two term Member of Parliament for Obuasi West constituency in the Ashanti Region of Ghana.

kusaal: Ba da du'a Kwaku Kwarteng nɛ Burnya nya'aŋ nwaris ayi' la li dabisim pii nɛ ayi' daar yυυm tusir nɛ kɔbisiwai nɛ piisyuobʋ nɛ awai la ni n bɛ Kokofu linɛ bɛ Ashanti Region, Ghana nwa la.
english: Kwaku Kwarteng was born on February 12, 1969, in Kokofu in the Ashanti Region of Ghana.

kusaal: O da keŋɛ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology linɛ bɛ Kumasi la naae ka di'e Digirii kasɛta gbaυŋ linɛ an civil engineering yυυm tusir nɛ kɔbiswai nɛ piswai nɛ ayuobʋ la ni.
english: He attended the Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology in nearby Kumasi, where he obtained a Bachelor of Science degree in civil engineering in 1996.

kusaal: O mɛ da lɛn keŋ University of Ghana maal o M.A. kasɛta gbaʋŋ kanɛ an Economic Policy Management la yυυm tusa ayi' nɛ awai la ni.
english: He also has an M.A. in Economic Policy Management from the University of Ghana in 2009.

kusaal: Yυυm tusa ayi' nɛ pii nɛ ayi' vɔɔt la ni la ka on nɛ John Alexander Ackon onɛ da an Ma'asim Tiig nid la nɛ Abubakar Sadick Iddris onɛ da an Progressive People's Party nid la nɛ Ayishetu Tahiru onɛ da an Ma'asim Na'adɔɔg nid la nɛ Isaac Fordjour onɛ da zi'en o mɛŋ nyari la, o da di ya ka bas ba wυsa.
english: In the 2012 General elections, he contested against John Alexander Ackon of the National Democratic Congress, Abubakar Sadick Iddris of the Progressive People's Party, Ayishetu Tahiru of the National Democratic Party, Mohammed Issifu of the People's National Convention, and the independent candidate Isaac Fordjour.

kusaal: Kwarteng da paamnɛ vɔt bam 31,101 n yi' vɔt la wυsa kanl linɛ da an 48,254 la ni, kɔbiga pυυginɛ o da mɔri 64.45% vɔt.
english: Kwarteng obtained 31,101 votes out of the 48,254 valid votes cast, which represented 64.45% of all votes cast.

kusaal: Burnya nya'aŋ nwarig yinne la yυυm tusa ayi' nɛ pii nɛ ayɔpɔi la ni ka Ghana Gɔmina Nana Akufo-Addo da gaŋ Kwarteng nɛ Charles Adu Boahen ye ba an Minista banɛ gɔsidi ti ligidi yɛla la nya'andɔlib.
english: In January 2017, President Nana Akufo-Addo nominated Kwarteng and Charles Adu Boahen to become the deputy ministers of finance.

kusaal: Ken Ofori-Atta aan ba kpɛɛm.
english: They were to work under Ken Ofori-Atta.

kusaal: Yυυm tusa ayi' nɛ pii nɛ ayuobʋ vɔɔt la ni la, ka ba vɔɔt ka o di, o da mɔri vɔɔt kal 32,049 ka NDC nid, John Alexander Ackon mɛ mɔr vɔɔt kal 11,587 .
english: In the 2016 Ghana general elections, he won the parliamentary seat with 32,049 votes whilst the NDC parliamentary aspirant John Alexander Ackon had 11,587 votes.

kusaal: Yυυm tusa ayi' nɛ pisi vɔɔt la ni ka ba da lɛn vɔɔt ka o di o da mɔri vɔɔt kal 33,383 ka NDC nid Faustilove Appiah Kannin mɛ mɔr vɔɔt kal 15,141 .
english: In the 2020 Ghana general elections, he won the parliamentary seat with 33,383 votes whilst the NDC parliamentary aspirant Faustilove Appiah Kannin had 15,141 votes.

kusaal: Kwaku Kwarteng tʋʋma pamm anɛ pɔlitis nwɛ'ɛb.
english: Much of the working life of Kwaku Kwarteng has been in politics.

kusaal: Ti Ghana Gɔmina kυdυg John Agyekum Kufour n da sig kυk la zug yυυm tusa ayi' nɛ awai la ni la, ka ba gaŋ o ye o an onɛ an sa'an-sa'an Wabυg Na'adɔɔg la ni, lin da yi yυυm tusa ayi' nɛ piiga la ni ti paae yυυm tusa ayi' nɛ pii nɛ atan' la ni la.
english: When the John Agyekum Kufour administration left power in 2009, he became a policy advisor for the New Patriotic Party from 2010 to 2013.

kusaal: Yυυm tusa ayi' nɛ pii nɛ yinne la ni ka Wabυg Na'adɔɔg dim la da gaŋ o ye o zi'enɛ nya' Obuasi West sυ'υlυm linɛ da nan yɔ'ɔg paalim la wadmaanib kυk la.
english: In 2011 he was elected as the New Patriotic Party candidate to contest the newly created Obuasi West constituency.

kusaal: Yυυma tusa yi' nɛ pii nɛ ayɔpɔi la ni ka kpɛɛm banɛ gɔsid Minista gaansυg yɛla la da gaŋ Kwarteng.
english: Kwarteng was vetted by the Appointments Committee of Parliament in March 2017.

kusaal: Saŋkanɛ ka ba da vɛɛnsidi o la o yɛl la da kɛnɛ ka John Dramani Mahama nwɛ' sam hali wυυ billion ayɔpɔi ti Ghana cedis la bɛ lυgυr kɔn'ɔb-kɔn'ɔb ni.
english: During his vetting, he claimed that the John Dramani Mahama administration had left outstanding arrears of 7 billion cedis owed various institutions in the country.

kusaal: Kwarteng di pu'a mɔr biis atan'.
english: Kwarteng is married with three children.

kusaal: O anɛ Wabυg Na'adɔɔg nid ka an Minista kanɛ gɔsidi ti ligidi nam yɛla la nya'andɔl.
english: He is also the Deputy Minister for Finance.

kusaal: Onɛ an ligidi Minista la nya'andɔl.
english: He is also the Deputy Minister for Finance.

kusaal: Nannanna onɛ an kpɛɛm banɛ gɔsidi ti ligidi yɛla la kυkdaan.
english: He is currently the Chairperson of the Finance Committee and also a member of the Communications Committee.

kusaal: Kwaku Sintim-Misa aka "KSM" (dʋ'am- yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ pisnu nɛ ayuobʋ, 1956) anɛ Ghana nid kanɛ an sini maan, siya sɔb, one tisid labaya,, nɛ gbansɔbid.
english: Kwaku Sintim-Misa aka "KSM" (born 1956) is a Ghanaian actor, director, satirist, talk show host, and author.

kusaal: One gɔsid di'em kanɛ buon The KSM Show la.
english: He is the host of The KSM Show.

kusaal: Da paas nɛ o dʋ'adib biis ayuobʋ ni ka ba dʋ'a o yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ pisnu nɛ yuobʋ, naar nwadig, daba nu daar (December 5, 1956), Kumasi tɛnpʋʋgin.
english: KSM was born the fifth of six siblings on December 5, 1956, in the city of Kumasi.

kusaal: O da kɛŋ UST Primary School, Presbyterian Boys' Senior High School, nɛ Prempeh College.
english: He attended UST Primary School, the Presbyterian Boys' Senior High School, and Prempeh College.

kusaal: On da naae college la, o da paam zamisigi yi lʋgir kanɛ nyɛ yʋ'ʋr Ghana kpala, National Film and Television Institute dinɛ bɛ Accra sʋ'ʋlim, Ghana la.
english: After completing college, he received specialized training at the renowned National Film and Television Institute in Accra Ghana.

kusaal: On da bɔɔd di'ema yela la, KSM da bas Africa sʋ'ʋlim yi na'asaatɛŋ ye o zamis sini maaligi bɛ Trinity College linɛ bɛ Connecticut , United States la.
english: Anxious for deeper knowledge in performing arts, KSM left Africa to major in acting and directing at Trinity College in Connecticut, United States.

kusaal: O da kɛŋ tuoni paam gbaŋ kanɛ an Master of Fine Arts in film production yi New York University.
english: He subsequently earned a Master of Fine Arts in film production from New York University.

kusaal: O da paasi maal sini kanɛ buon American crime series Law & Order nɛ sini kanɛ an Medal of Honor Rag (tuongat da anɛ one di'e ya'an piini yi Tony Award ni, Lloyd Richards.) KSM da an African nid kanɛ an yiiga da maal sini bɛ Off-Broadway on da maal di'ema kanɛ buon Thoughts of a Confused Black Man, on ma'a da maali li pa'al nidibi nɛ'ɛsid taaba bɛ United States sʋ'ʋlim si'em.
english: He also appeared in the American crime series Law & Order and on the drama series Medal of Honor Rag (by the Tony Award winning director Lloyd Richards.) KSM became the first African to stage an original Off-Broadway play when he produced Thoughts of a Confused Black Man, a one-man show about race in the United States.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ piswai nɛ ayɔpɔi (1997) ka o da lɛb Ghana.
english: In 1997 he returned to Ghana.

kusaal: Nidibi da mi' o ye o anɛ one pian'ad walis ni la, KSM da pin'il di'ema kanɛ nyɛ yʋ'ʋr hali Ghana kpala: Thank God It's Friday (TGIF).
english: After working as a radio host, KSM created the talk show Thank God It's Friday (TGIF).

kusaal: KSM da di'e ya'an piini kanɛ an Radio and Television Personality Television Entertainment Show Host of the Year (2011) on da maan di'em kanɛ an TGIF la yela.
english: KSM won the Radio and Television Personality Television Entertainment Show Host of the Year (2011) for his work with TGIF.

kusaal: KSM sɔb di'ema gbana, ka gaad tuoni maali ba, ka maal di'em banɛ an siya di'ema wʋsa, si'eba anɛ Saga of a Returnee, Afia Siriboe, nɛ Politically Incorrect.
english: KSM has written, directed, and starred in a series of one-man comedic plays, most notably Saga of a Returnee, Afia Siriboe, and Politically Incorrect.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusayi nɛ awai la (2009), KSM da yis sini kanɛ wa'am bi'ela ka pʋdi li yʋ'ʋr ye Double.
english: In 2009, KSM released his first feature-length film, a psychological thriller entitled Double.

kusaal: O sɔb di'ema gbana ka maal sini di'ema Tv nam ni, ka ba si'eba an Hot Bench, Divorce Court, Action Security, nɛ laafi yela sini nam.
english: He has written and produced a variety of television shows, including Hot Bench, Divorce Court, Action Security, and several medical documentaries.

kusaal: Ogya FM anɛ o TV ni tʋʋm kanɛ ka o tʋm daba yi' nwa, linɛ an ye li sa'al nidib ban na paam ti'akir yela, ka ba gɔsi li bɛ Panafrican Film and Television Festival of Ouagadougou linɛ Burkina Faso sʋ'ʋlim la.
english: Ogya FM was recently shown at the Panafrican Film and Television Festival of Ouagadougou in Burkina Faso.

kusaal: Godfried Kwadwo Sintim-Misa, one da an kpɛɛm tis Presbyterian Church of Ghana, nɛ Mary Oforiwaa Sintim-Misa.
english: Rev. Godfried Kwadwo Sintim-Misa, a former Moderator of the Presbyterian Church of Ghana, and Mary Oforiwaa Sintim-Misa.

kusaal: O mɔr pʋ'a nɛ biis anu ka ba yinne an rapper Yaw (Blackway).
english: He is married with five children including rapper Blackway.

kusaal: KSM da pin'il o sini maalig nɛ Off-Broadway nɛ di'ema maalig.
english: KSM launched his acting career with a variety of Off-Broadway and Public Theatre roles.

kusaal: On da lɛb na la, pʋ yʋʋgɛ ka o kilim one pian'ad walisin; on da tʋm nɛ Talk Shop la da kɛ ka Ghana sɔnsid walis pʋʋgin.
english: Shortly after arriving back in the country, KSM became a radio talk show host; his work with Talk Shop introduced Ghana to broadcasting's potential for generating controversy and dialogue.

kusaal: KSM mɔr baŋir nɛ pian'ad pʋʋgin ka linɛ kɛ ka banɛ kɛlisid la'asid nɛ o pian'ad tɛnmaalig yela.
english: KSM used a combative, confrontational style which shocked his listeners into discussing relevant national issues.

kusaal: KSM's mɔr nɛ o siya la maani pa'an nidib bɛilim, ligidi iieb, nɛ gɔmɛna na'adɔɔg dɔlisim yela Ghana sʋ'ʋlim.
english: KSM's live performances use comical characters to illustrate the key social, economic, and political issues concerning Ghana.

kusaal: Lʋgir kanɛ gɔsidi li yela anɛ Sapphire Ghana Limited, di'ema zin'ig kanɛ ka o da pin'ili li, ka dɔlisi maal di'ema pa'al ninsaal bɛilim an si'em.
english: They are produced by Sapphire Ghana Limited, a content development company that he founded and uses to integrate social issues into television, radio, and stage productions.

kusaal: Banɛ da dʋ'a Sintim-Misa anɛ Rt.
english: Sintim-Misa was born to Rt.

kusaal: Eric Kwakye Darfour anɛ Ghana pɔlitis nwɛ'ɛd ka paas Wabʋg Na'adɔɔg, New Patriotic Party dinɛ bɛ Ghana la nidib ni.
english: Eric Kwakye Darfour (born 1957) is a Ghanaian politician and a member of the New Patriotic Party in Ghana.

kusaal: Onɛ an Eastern Regional minista tis Ghana.
english: He is the Eastern Regional minister of Ghana.

kusaal: Zugraan Nana Addo Danquah Akuffo-Addo da gaŋ o yʋʋm tusa ayi' nɛ piinɛ ayɔpɔi yʋʋmpaal nwadig la ni (yʋʋmpaal nwadig 2017) ka Wadmaanib da siak ka tisi o suor yʋʋm tusa ayi' nɛ pii nɛ ayɔpɔi nwadisa ayi' la ni (fʋlʋnfʋk nwadig 2017).
english: He was appointed by President Nana Addo Danquah Akuffo-Addo in January 2017 and was approved by the Members of Parliament in February 2017.

kusaal: Ba da dʋ'a o nɛ yʋʋm tusir nɛ kɔbiswai nɛ pisnu nɛ ayɔpɔi nwadisa awai la dabpisi nɛ awai daar (29th selʋŋ nwadig, 1957) bɛ Achimota Accra sʋ'ʋlʋm .
english: He was born on the 29 September 1957 in Achimota Accra.

kusaal: O da pin'ili o basic education nɛ Obo Government School kanɛ bɛ Obo Kwahu la, o mɛŋ teŋin.
english: He started his basic education at Obo Government School in Obo Kwahu his hometown.

kusaal: John Grammar School nɛ Ofori Panin Senior High maali kanɛ aan o 'O" Level nɛ 'A' Level nwɛnnɛ Sakuya la yʋda dɔl taaba si'em la.
english: After his middle school certificate he processed to St. John Grammar School and Ofori Panin Senior High for his 'O' Level And 'A' Level respectively.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusir nɛ kɔbiswai nɛ pisnii nɛ yinne, (1981) la ni, Kwakye Darfour da keŋ University of Dakar linɛ bɛ Senegal la n maali o higher diploma in French ka din nya'aŋ ka o paam BA (HONS) in French nɛ Linguistics yit University of Ghana, Legon.
english: In 1981, Kwakye Darfour studied in the University of Dakar, Senegal for a higher diploma in French and later acquired BA (HONS) in French and Linguistics from University of Ghana, Legon.

kusaal: o da mɔri vɔɔt kal pisyɔpɔi nɛ atan du'al pisnaasi nɛ anii pʋdigir kɔbʋg pʋʋgin (73.48%) yit vɔɔt la wʋsa ni yʋʋm tusa ayi nɛ piinɛ ayuobʋ kanɛ da an (2016) Ghana wʋsa vɔɔtʋgin la.
english: He was elected in 2012 Ghanaian general elections and re-elected in 2017 after obtaining 73.48% of votes cast.

kusaal: Ba da vɔɔt gaŋ o yʋʋm tusa ayi' nɛ pii nɛ ayi' kanɛ da an (2012) Ghana wʋsa vɔɔtʋg la ka lɛn vɔɔti tis o ya'as yʋʋm tusa ayi' nɛ pii nɛ ayɔpɔi la ni (2017).
english: He was elected in 2012 Ghanaian general elections and re-elected in 2017 after obtaining 73.48% of votes cast.

kusaal: Kwame Anyimadu-Antwi (dʋ'anɛ 12 vaala nwadig 1962) anɛ Ghana lɔya nɛ pɔlitis nwɛ'ɛd.
english: Kwame Anyimadu-Antwi (born 12 April 1962) is a Ghanaian lawyer and politician.

kusaal: O anɛ Wadmaani tis Asante-Akim Central constituency bɛ wadmaanib yikanɛ paasi ayɔpɔi nɛ anii Ghana republic kanɛ paasi anaasi la ni yit Ashanti Region.
english: He is a member of parliament for Asante-Akim Central constituency in the Seventh Parliament and 8th Parliament of the fourth Republic of Ghana in the Ashanti Region, a position he has held since 2009.

kusaal: Nannanna, o anɛ board member tis VRA ka lɛn an kʋkdaani tis Ghana National Fire Service Council.
english: Currently, he is a board member of VRA and also the chairperson for the Ghana National Fire Service Council.

kusaal: Anyimadu-Antwi da keŋ KNUST maali o BSc in Land Economy.
english: Anyimadu-Antwi attended KNUST and had his BSc in Land Economy.

kusaal: O da lɛn maal certificate in Project Planning and Management at GIMPA, nɛ MBA University of Ghana, bɛ Legon la.
english: He earned a certificate in Project Planning and Management at GIMPA, and an MBA at the University of Ghana, Legon.

kusaal: o lɛn anɛ Barrister in Law ka da kpɛn' Bar la Ghana School of Law ni.
english: He qualified as Barrister in Law and was called to the Bar at the Ghana School of Law.

kusaal: O mɔr masters of law (LLM) degree in Intellectual Property Law yi University of London.
english: He has a masters of law (LLM) degree in Intellectual Property Law from the University of London.

kusaal: O da lɛn tʋm Land Valuation Division aan assistance valuer din yi yʋʋm tusir nɛ kɔbiswai nɛ pisnii nɛ awai (1989) ti paaae yʋʋm tusir nɛ kɔbiswai nɛ piswai nɛ yinne (1991).
english: He worked at the Land Valuation Division as an assistance valuer from 1989 to 1991.

kusaal: O da anɛ Estate Officer sʋŋid manager la State Insurance Company bɛ Ghana ka yʋ'ʋn an chief executive officer tis real estate (private consultant).
english: He was then employed as the Estate Officer to assist the manager at the State Insurance Company Of Ghana but now the chief executive officer at real estate (private consultant).

kusaal: O anɛ wadmaani tis Asante-Akim North Constituency, o di'e yinɛ Minista kʋdʋg Kwadwo Baah-Wiredu kanɛ da gɔsid ligidi nɛ nu'ug tʋʋma nam yɛla, ka da maal ka'alim la yʋma anaasi ma'aa (2009-2013).
english: He served as member of parliament for Asante-Akim North Constituency succeeding the former Minister for Finance and Economic Planning, the late Kwadwo Baah-Wiredu for one term between 2009 and 2013.

kusaal: Yʋʋm tusa ayi' nɛ pii nɛ ayi' (2012) la ni, Asante Akim North da lɛn maligim pʋrnɛ zin'isa ayi' ka du'a Asante Akim Central Constituency dinɛ bɛ Asante Akim-Central Municipal ka pʋn dɛŋim bɛ Asante Akim North Constituency.
english: In 2012, the Asante Akim North was rezoned and divided into two birthing the Asante Akim Central Constituency which fell under the Asante Akim-Central Municipal and the already existing Asante Akim North Constituency.

kusaal: O da zi'enya ka ba lɛn vɔɔt tis o yʋʋm tusa ayi' nɛ pii nɛ ayuobʋ (2016) vɔɔtʋg kanɛ an Asante Akim Central bɛ Ashanti region sʋ'ʋlim, Ghana nwa.
english: He stood to be re-elected into the next parliament in the 2016 elections for the Asante Akim Central in the Ashanti region of Ghana.

kusaal: Ba da vɔɔt o ka o kpɛn' ɔfis dinɛ paasi o nɔ'ɔra atan' daan la yʋʋm tusa ayi' nɛ pii nɛ ayuobʋ (2016) Ghana wʋsa vɔɔtʋg la ni ka o di nɛ vɔɔt kal pisyɔpɔi nɛ anu du'al piswai kɔbʋg pʋʋgin (75.90%).
english: He was voted into office for a third term after defeating his opposition in the 2016 general elections, winning with 75.90% of the total votes cast.

english: Kwame Twumasi Ampofo (born 3 June 1968) is a Ghanaian politician and a current member of the 7th Parliament of the 4th Republic of Ghana and a member of the Eighth Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana representing the Sene West Constituency in the Bono East Region of Ghana on the ticket of the National Democratic Congress (NDC).

kusaal: Ba da dʋ'a Ampofo nɛ yʋʋm tusir, kɔbiswai nɛ pisyuobʋ nɛ anii Nwadisa atan la daba ayuobʋ daar (6 March 1968) Kwame Danso, tenkanɛ bɛ Bono East Region, Ghana.
english: Ampofo was born on 6 March 1968 in Kwame Danso, a town in the Bono East Region of Ghana.

kusaal: O da keŋnɛ Essex County College, NJ, USA, yʋʋm tusa ayi nɛ anu la ni (2005) ka lɛn maal BSC in Business Management.

kusaal: Vɔɔtʋgin la, o da paam vɔɔt tusa piinɛ ayi, kɔbisnu nɛ piinɛ yinne (12,511) yi vɔɔt tusa piinɛ awai, kɔbisnu nɛ anaasi (19,504) dinɛ zi'eni ti pisyuobʋ nɛ anaasi dua'al piinɛ anaasi kɔbiga pʋʋgin (64.14%).
english: During the elections, he polled 12,511 votes out of the 19,504 valid votes cast representing 64.14%.

kusaal: O da nya'a yʋʋm tusa ayi nɛ piinɛ ayuobʋ (2016) Ghana vɔɔtʋg la ka paam vɔɔt tusa piiga, kɔbisyi' nɛ pisi nɛ awai (10,229) dinɛ an piswai nɛ yinne dua'al pisnii nɛ ayuobʋ kɔbiga pʋʋgin (51.86%) ka NPP nid la, Joseph Mackay Kumah paam vɔɔt tusa anii, kɔbisyɔpɔi nɛ pisnaasi nɛ ayɔpɔi (8,747) dinɛ an pisnaasi nɛ anaasi dua'ali atan (44.3%), PPP nid la, Dramani Manu paam vɔɔt kɔbisnu nɛ pisyuobʋ nɛ anu (565) dinɛ an ayi' du'ali awai kɔbiga pʋʋgin (2.9%) ka CPP nid la, Daniyawu Mohammed paam kɔbiga nɛ pisnii nɛ anaasi (184) dinɛ mɛ an nɛɛm du'al awai kɔbiga pʋʋgin (0.9%).
english: He contested again in the 2016 Ghanaian general elections and polled 10,229 votes making 51.86% of the total votes cast whilst the NPP parliamentary candidate Joseph Mackay Kumah had 8,747 making 44.3% of the total votes cast, the PPP parliamentary candidate Dramani Manu had 565 votes making 2.9% of the total votes and the CPP parliamentary candidate Daniyawu Mohammed had 184 votes making 0.9% of the total votes cast.

kusaal: O da lɛn nya' yʋʋm tusa ayi nɛ pisi (2020) Ghana wʋsa vɔɔtʋg la ka paam vɔɔt tusa piinɛ atan, kɔbiga nɛ piinɛ ayuobʋ (13,116) ka NPP nid la, Joseph Markay Kuma paam vɔɔt tusa piinɛ atan nɛ kɔbiga (13,100).
